jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate - Freelance
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Conduct clinical site monitoring visits throughout the study lifecycle, including Site Selection Visits (SSVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and Close-Out Visits (COVs). Ensure investigator sites operate in accordance with clinical study protocols, ICH-GCP guidelines, sponsor requirements, and applicable local regulations. Monitor patient safety, clinical data quality, and study documentation to maintain compliance and support reliable trial outcomes. Manage investigator sites from initiation through close-out, ensuring monitoring activities are completed effectively and in line with study requirements. Build and maintain strong working relationships with investigators, site personnel, and sponsor stakeholders. Support site readiness, patient recruitment activities, and the resolution of operational issues that could affect study progress or timelines. Identify, document, and escalate site-level risks, deviations, and challenges while contributing to risk-based monitoring strategies. Maintain accurate monitoring records and ensure essential study documentation is complete and up to date. Support audit and inspection readiness activities, helping ensure sites meet quality and regulatory expectations. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related discipline. At least 3 years of independent clinical monitoring experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry. Demonstrated experience monitoring medical device clinical studies. Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable clinical research regulatory requirements. Proven experience managing clinical trial sites throughout the full study lifecycle, from initiation to close-out. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with fluency in both languages required. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with investigators, site teams, and sponsor stakeholders. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage monitoring activities and resolve issues independently. Nice to Have: Experience with Medical Device Regulation (MDR) submissions. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within Germany. Freelance contract offering flexibility in how you manage your professional commitments. Opportunity to work on clinical research activities for a global pharmaceutical sponsor. Collaboration with experienced clinical research professionals in an international environment. Opportunities for personal and professional development. Work within a quality-focused culture built around trust, collaboration, flexibility, passion, and sustainability. Opportunity to contribute to clinical research that supports patient safety and advances healthcare.

jobs.title: Head of Content & Brand
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define, document, and lead the overall editorial strategy, including content themes, positioning, points of view, formats, and channel priorities. Ensure a consistent and recognizable brand voice and visual identity across all content and communications. Build and activate a network of internal and external contributors, including executives, customer advocates, and partners, to broaden the brand's reach and perspectives. Own audience growth as a measurable business objective, setting targets across owned channels and relevant industry or partner ecosystems. Track audience engagement and content performance, translating insights into pipeline-related metrics and collaborating with Go-to-Market (GTM) and Revenue Operations (RevOps) teams on attribution. Lead, coach, and develop a team of three specialists responsible for video content, brand design, and written content, establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability. Serve as the primary connection between Brand and GTM, ensuring content supports commercial objectives without compromising editorial consistency. Partner with demand generation and sales teams to deliver landing pages, advertising creative, nurture sequences, and sales enablement materials. Establish regular cross-functional planning and communication routines to maintain alignment, remove blockers, and ensure effective execution. Requirements: Proven experience in a broad, end-to-end content leadership role within a B2B SaaS environment. Demonstrated success building and growing an engaged target audience and turning content performance into measurable business value. Strong ability to develop, communicate, and defend an editorial strategy using data, insights, and clear reasoning. Excellent editorial judgment, with the confidence to maintain a consistent brand voice while partnering effectively with commercial teams and senior leadership. Experience managing and developing content and creative specialists, with strong coaching, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Ability to connect brand and editorial concepts with commercial objectives, including ideal customer profile (ICP) reach, audience quality, engagement, and pipeline contribution. Strong understanding of content distribution and audience development across platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts. Fluency in English is required; French language skills are considered an asset. Comfortable using AI-powered writing and production tools, content management systems (CMS), social media management platforms, and analytics tools. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to operate in a distributed, international environment. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Co-maintain and progressively take technical ownership of an open-source PostgreSQL schema comparison and migration engine, reviewing contributions and eventually growing into its lead maintainer. Review, evaluate, and merge code contributions, including AI-generated pull requests, while ensuring high standards of correctness, maintainability, and security. Investigate and resolve reported issues related to schema differences, dependency ordering, migration generation, and PostgreSQL compatibility. Expand automated testing and validation coverage across multiple PostgreSQL versions to ensure consistent and reliable behavior. Ensure generated database migrations are safe, privilege-aware, and designed to prevent unintended data loss or security regressions. Identify potentially destructive schema changes and implement mechanisms to detect them and generate safer alternatives wherever possible. Contribute to the development of a stable 1.0 release, including defining public APIs, establishing semantic versioning contracts, improving documentation, and expanding PostgreSQL extension support. Engage with the open-source community by managing issue reports, reviewing external contributions, providing technical guidance, and maintaining constructive discussions with contributors. Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure consistent migration generation and execution across products, platform services, database branching, and AI-powered workflows. Write technical design documents, define architectural direction, and establish engineering strategies for the continued evolution of the tooling. Participate in the engineering team's on-call rotation, helping investigate and resolve production-related issues while supporting reliable software delivery. Requirements: At least 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL. Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, particularly system catalogs such as pg_catalog and pg_depend , object ownership, permissions, grants, default privileges, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, and extension membership. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL DDL operations and database migration semantics, including locking behavior, transactional limitations, dependency management, and the identification of potentially destructive changes. A security-conscious engineering mindset, with particular attention to preventing unauthorized privilege changes, accidental access exposure, and unintended data loss. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and the ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software. Experience designing advanced testing strategies for correctness, including differential testing, property-based testing, and test corpus validation across multiple PostgreSQL versions. Familiarity with compiler-style engineering challenges, including dependency graphs, topological sorting, cycle detection, and schema comparison algorithms. Ability to review and understand complex code changes within sophisticated codebases, including contributions generated with AI-assisted development tools. Proven experience owning and maintaining production software, including staged releases, error monitoring, incident investigation, and responding to real-world user feedback. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, from initial problem definition and architectural planning through production implementation. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to document technical decisions clearly. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and collaborate successfully within asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams. Nice to Have: Previous experience developing or maintaining database schema comparison and migration tools such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, Flyway, or Liquibase. Familiarity with PostgreSQL backup and sc

jobs.title: Middle Manual QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the regression testing strategy: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve a structured regression testing approach for the existing enterprise application. Analyze business workflows: Collaborate with the customer’s team to investigate, reverse-engineer, and document critical business processes and user scenarios. Explore application functionality: Identify key features, edge cases, undocumented business rules, and areas of potential risk within the existing system. Design comprehensive test scenarios: Create regression, characterization (golden master), and exploratory test cases before significant system changes or modernization activities. Perform manual testing: Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and release validation checks to verify application behavior and identify defects. Validate APIs and HTTP interactions: Conduct manual API and HTTP testing to confirm the reliability of critical application functionality and workflows. Introduce basic automation: Work with engineers and AI-assisted tools to develop simple automated checks for selected high-priority workflows and APIs. Support CI/CD integration: Help incorporate automated checks into Azure DevOps pipelines and review execution results. Contribute to release quality: Perform security-related checks and support release cycles by identifying and communicating potential issues. Support User Acceptance Testing: Assist the customer with UAT activities, helping validate that application functionality meets business expectations. Investigate defects: Analyze test failures, application logs, and stack traces to help identify potential causes and communicate findings to developers. Collaborate with engineering and product teams: Work with developers and the Product Owner to clarify requirements, investigate unexpected behavior, and resolve ambiguities. Maintain QA documentation: Keep test cases, regression suites, test results, and other quality assurance documentation clear, organized, and up to date. Requirements: Professional experience: At least 4 years of experience in manual quality assurance or software testing, primarily involving web applications or backend systems. Testing fundamentals: Strong understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality assurance methodologies. Regression testing expertise: Practical experience designing and maintaining regression test suites, smoke tests, sanity checks, and release validation criteria. Business analysis and risk assessment: Ability to independently understand business workflows, identify potential risks, and translate requirements into clear, effective test cases. Exploratory and API testing: Hands-on experience with exploratory testing and API validation. Web and HTTP knowledge: Good understanding of HTTP fundamentals, cookies, sessions, and typical web application architecture. API testing tools: Practical experience using tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or curl. CI/CD and Azure DevOps: Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps (ADO), including executing existing jobs, reviewing pipeline results, and investigating failures. Technical troubleshooting: Basic familiarity with application logs, stack traces, and build tools. Communication and documentation: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate level of English or higher. Nice to Have: Test automation: Basic automation experience or a willingness to learn and introduce simple automated checks with support from AI-assisted tools. Java testing frameworks: Familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Selenium, Selenide, or REST Assured. AI-assisted development: Experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate basic test scripts or test skeletons, together with the ability to review and validate generated code. jobs.title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own linguistic quality standards for the Belarusian locale, ensuring consistent interpretation and application of client requirements across all relevant content types. Review style guide and glossary updates, assess their impact on quality categories and content types, and document changes and evolving expectations. Monitor client feedback, corrections, and decisions from calibration and quality meetings to identify implicit expectations and maintain alignment with the client’s Language Manager. Serve as the primary linguistic contact for quality discussions, clarifications, arbitration, and escalations, ensuring concerns are supported by clear evidence. Organize regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish monthly quality reports covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, recurring errors, and arbitration outcomes. Coach reviewers individually using specific examples and conduct shadowing sessions based on real alignment data. Analyze error patterns, severity trends, and alignment scores to identify opportunities for quality improvement. Convert recurring justification patterns into well-supported style guide proposals and share relevant cross-locale insights with quality management. Maintain ownership of the locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance, the community’s shared understanding of quality, and the integrity of arbitration records. Build and maintain an effective working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, tracking expectations and helping reduce quality discrepancies over time. Requirements: 3–5+ years of experience in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), senior language lead positions, or quality governance roles. Proven experience managing client and stakeholder relationships, ideally as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers. Hands-on experience managing formal arbitration and escalation processes, facilitating discussions, and resolving linguistic disagreements. Strong practical knowledge of localization quality evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping. Ability to analyze style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and understand differing quality requirements across content types such as marketing, legal, and UI. Experience facilitating one-to-one coaching, reviewer shadowing, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting. Strong analytical skills, including the ability to track error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and translate findings into actionable improvements. Native-level Belarusian proficiency and professional-level English. Excellent communication, organization, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Preferred: Previous experience supporting large-scale technology localization programs and familiarity with calibration or alignment tools. Benefits: Freelance / independent contractor engagement with an expected workload of approximately 24 hours per month. Opportunity to build a long-term partnership with global teams working on high-visibility technology products. Steady project volume and ongoing collaboration. Comprehensive onboarding and continued learning opportunities. Access to established linguistic resources and quality processes. Dedicated device provided for project-related work. Remote working arrangement, provided you are physically located in one of the approved countries. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Accounting Manager, you will oversee the complete accounting function, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and compliance with relevant accounting standards. You will work closely with leadership and accounting support teams to maintain reliable financial records and improve financial processes. Manage the full accounting cycle, including account reconciliations, month-end closing, and year-end closing. Prepare and deliver accurate monthly financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense management, and vendor payments. Identify billing discrepancies, unusual transactions, and potential financial errors to protect business resources. Integrate external tools and applications with accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online to streamline workflows. Prepare accurate and organized financial records for annual reviews and external CPA firms. Support leadership with budgeting, financial forecasting, and cash flow planning. Develop and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures as the business grows. Supervise and support bookkeepers or accounting staff, providing guidance and constructive feedback. Use digital collaboration and accounting tools, including QuickBooks Online, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Bill.com, Gusto, Ramp, and ClickUp. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting professional with a strong understanding of U.S. accounting practices, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to independently manage financial operations. You should be comfortable working in a remote environment, communicating financial information clearly, and taking ownership of accounting processes. At least 5 years of accounting experience working with U.S.-based companies, including full-cycle accounting responsibilities. Strong knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP). Advanced experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting platform, including integrating third-party applications. CPA certification or a local accounting qualification, such as Contador Público, is an advantage. Previous experience collaborating with external CPA firms or supporting multiple clients is a plus. Experience supervising, mentoring, or guiding accounting professionals, even without a formal management title. Strong financial judgment and the ability to navigate fast-paced business environments. Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to provide clear updates to remote teams. High levels of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Must be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe. Benefits: Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently on a monthly basis and determined by experience. 10 paid vacation days per year. All U.S. national holidays observed. 100% remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe. Opportunity to work directly with business leaders and contribute to important financial decisions. Collaborative, supportive, and high-trust working environment. Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the planning and execution of major creative programs, ensuring that deliverables meet strategic objectives, retailer specifications, production requirements, and launch deadlines. Your responsibilities will include: Lead end-to-end planning and artwork delivery for high-priority Shopper creative programs, including in-store displays, shelf signage, toppers, clings, point-of-sale materials, and retailer-specific collateral. Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and establish project-specific timelines covering briefs, concept development, design iterations, stakeholder reviews, packaging renders, proofing, production lead times, and final delivery. Partner with Shopper project managers and teams across Brand, Innovation, Commercialization, and Production to define project scope, deliverables, requirements, and priorities. Coordinate creative milestones with broader Shopper programs, retail media initiatives, promotional campaigns, and product launch schedules. Maintain accurate project plans in Asana, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, decisions, and progress visibility. Identify risks and potential blockers early, make informed trade-off decisions, and escalate high-impact issues to leadership with clear recommendations. Lead creative workflow coordination and artwork handoffs across Shopper initiatives, packaging, trade show assets, and sales materials. Organize project kickoffs, working sessions, stakeholder reviews, and approval processes, ensuring feedback is consolidated and decisions are reached efficiently. Coordinate with Creative leads and production partners on design requirements, print specifications, file formats, production feasibility, and delivery timelines. Manage packaging render development, print proofing, pilot participation, and production-readiness reviews. Ensure retailer-specific creative guidelines, asset requirements, and approval processes are reflected in project plans. Identify recurring workflow challenges and implement scalable improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across the Creative function. Mentor colleagues on project planning, stakeholder communication, accountability, and creative program management best practices. Stay informed about retail, Shopper marketing, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) trends, sharing relevant insights and solutions with the wider team. You should understand how creative development and production requirements interact, and be comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment. Key qualifications include: 8+ years of project or program management experience, ideally within the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, an in-house creative team, or an agency environment. Demonstrated experience leading large, high-priority creative programs with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams. Strong knowledge of Shopper creative formats and retail environments, including in-store displays, point-of-sale materials, shelf signage, and retailer-specific collateral. Deep understanding of the creative development process, from briefing and concept exploration through design iterations, reviews, approvals, production readiness, and final artwork delivery. Experience coordinating creative deliverables for major retailers and adapting workflows to different specifications, guidelines, and approval requirements. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies that attract qualified prospects, improve conversion rates, and support business growth. Own and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture through Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and sales opportunities. Maintain accountability for lead quality, pipeline contribution, and the overall effectiveness of marketing initiatives. Manage marketing projects end to end, including market research, strategic planning, campaign development, execution, testing, performance analysis, and continuous optimization. Plan and implement organic-first, multi-channel growth programs, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives. Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data. Monitor and report on the entire lead-generation funnel, analyzing traffic acquisition, landing-page engagement, lead capture, nurturing, qualification, and conversion. Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve user experience, increase conversions, and strengthen lead-generation performance. Continuously optimize website performance, organic search visibility, user experience, and conversion rates, implementing improvements independently or in collaboration with specialists. Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams. Work closely with Sales to understand lead quality, customer needs, and market feedback, using these insights to refine audience targeting, messaging, and campaign effectiveness. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, with a demonstrated track record of generating qualified leads and improving marketing performance. Experience in B2B software development, IT services, SaaS, or the technology sector, preferably involving complex buying journeys and longer sales cycles. At least 2 years of experience owning marketing campaigns or cross-functional initiatives from strategic planning through execution and performance evaluation. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing, including content, email, social media, PPC, and CRO. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AEO, including keyword research, search intent, and strategies for improving organic visibility. Strong analytical capabilities and hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or comparable analytics and reporting tools. Ability to connect marketing activities and performance metrics to qualified leads, sales pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Strong proficiency with AI tools and practical experience using them to improve research, content creation, data analysis, and campaign workflows. Solid understanding of audience segmentation, targeting, positioning, and messaging, with the ability to develop compelling value propositions for different customer groups. Proactive, ownership-driven mindset, with a willingness to experiment, prioritize initiatives based on potential impact, and move projects forward independently. Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, guide specialists, and provide constructive feedback. Fluent English proficiency at C1 level or higher. Nice-to-have qualifications: Experience with marketing automation tools, CRM platforms, email nurturing sequences, and lead qualification processes. Advanced knowledge of conversion rate optimization, landing-page experimentation, and user behavior analysis. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the freedom to work from anywhere with a stable internet connection. Flexible working hours and the ability to choose a preferred time zone and work schedule. Competitive, negotiable hourly

jobs.title: Showrunner - Storyby
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take full creative ownership of individual film projects, ensuring quality and consistency throughout the entire production lifecycle. Develop concepts and stories for vertical series, from initial ideas and synopses to episode outlines and finalized scripts. Build compelling season narratives, including character and romantic arcs, conflicts, emotional turning points, engaging hooks, and cliffhangers. Review, edit, and provide constructive feedback on scripts, ensuring they meet creative and storytelling expectations. Oversee editing and post-production, reviewing cuts and providing direction on pacing, narrative structure, music, sound, emotional impact, and overall storytelling. Conduct final creative quality checks to ensure each finished film aligns with its original vision and content standards. Collaborate closely with screenwriters, producers, editors, and other creative professionals throughout production. Research vertical dramas, short-form entertainment, and emerging market trends, translating insights into innovative content strategies. Analyze audience feedback and post-release performance metrics to identify opportunities and apply learnings to future productions. Leverage AI-powered tools to support content development, creative iteration, and production workflows. Requirements: Hands-on experience writing or developing scripts for films, television series, digital entertainment, or short-form content. Strong understanding of dramatic storytelling and serialized narratives, including character development, pacing, conflict, hooks, and cliffhangers. Knowledge of editing and post-production processes, with an understanding of how scene structure, music, sound, and editing choices influence audience engagement. Ability to oversee a production holistically, from initial script development to final editing, making creative decisions that strengthen the finished story. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the overall creative outcome of each production. Understanding of mobile-first audiences and the specific storytelling techniques that distinguish vertical series from traditional films and television. Ability to manage multiple creative iterations efficiently and give and receive constructive feedback. Excellent creative judgment, independent decision-making, and problem-solving skills. English proficiency at B2 level or above. Nice to have: Experience working on vertical dramas or microdramas. Previous collaboration with video editors and post-production teams. Experience in performance marketing or working closely with performance teams, with an understanding of how creative concepts, hooks, and storytelling influence audience attention and conversion. Familiarity with content formats and trends on platforms such as ReelShort, DramaBox, and ShortMax. Experience using AI tools for text, image, or video generation. Understanding of content performance metrics, including retention and completion rates. Experience working across screenwriting, production management, and creative development. Benefits: End-to-end creative ownership: Take responsibility for each production from the first creative concept through to the final release, with the opportunity to shape its story, characters, script, editing, and overall performance. Meaningful creative impact: Directly influence the quality, direction, and success of digital entertainment products designed to engage global audiences. Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced professionals, creative specialists, producers, and business leaders, with opportunities to exchange knowledge and expertise. Professional development: Access specialized learning programs, management training, AI-focused workshops, and professional communities to continuously develop your skills. Knowledge-sharing culture: Benefit from a strong professional network and access to expertise across multiple business functions. Social impact opportunities: Particip

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst based in India. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming financial data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. You will work closely with accounting, operations, and leadership teams at growing U.S.-based businesses, providing accurate reporting, financial forecasts, and performance analysis. Your responsibilities will span financial modeling, budgeting, KPI tracking, and process improvement. You will help identify financial trends, uncover discrepancies, monitor costs, and improve reporting accuracy. Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Reconcile financial data across accounting systems and other business tools, identifying inconsistencies and resolving errors proactively. Monitor cost increases, declining profit margins, and unusual financial transactions to identify potential risks and improvement opportunities. Establish and maintain data standards and reporting practices to ensure financial records remain accurate and consistent as the business grows. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and structured financial modeling. Practical knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable accounting software. Experience using financial dashboards, reporting platforms, and data visualization tools. Strong analytical abilities and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify meaningful discrepancies and financial trends. Ability to interpret complex financial information and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders without a finance background. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the confidence to raise concerns and recommend improvements. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with accounting, operations, and leadership teams. Availability to work in alignment with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Must be based in India. Nice to have: SQL knowledge or experience working with financial data through database queries. jobs.title: Assurance Climate Risk Consultant
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and refine climate risk indicators and comprehensive frameworks covering both physical and transition risks. Design indicators using the IPCC AR6 hazard, exposure, and vulnerability framework, including thresholds, normalization methods, scoring and classification logic, and aggregation from grid cells to assets, basins, and portfolios. Support the development of climate scenario analysis solutions aligned with IFRS S2 and ESRS methodologies, including selecting, processing, and validating climate projection datasets across emissions scenarios, time horizons, and baseline periods. Prepare detailed indicator specifications, data dictionaries, and methodology documentation that Product and Engineering teams can implement and that provide sufficient auditability for client disclosures. Assess the financial implications of climate scenarios, including cost modeling and financial impact assessments across sectors such as manufacturing, technology, and textiles. Contribute to the development of climate resilience and adaptation opportunity libraries linked to identified potential risks. Validate climate indicators against observed data and published benchmarks, conduct sensitivity analyses, and establish methods for communicating uncertainty and confidence to platform users. Support climate-related disclosure preparation in accordance with CSRD/ESRS and IFRS S2, including identifying and mapping relevant data points, metrics, and reporting requirements. Lead and support CSRD limited-assurance readiness activities by establishing evidence trails, controls, and documentation capable of withstanding external assurance reviews. Monitor and interpret evolving CSRD/ESRS and IFRS regulatory guidance, identifying changes that may affect ongoing projects and internal methodologies. Collaborate with the Professional Services team to translate technical climate and disclosure requirements into practical internal frameworks, methodologies, and deliverables. Contribute to CSRD requirements gap analyses and define the work needed for preliminary disclosures, dry runs, and first-time reporting exercises. Ensure consistency and alignment between climate risk methodologies and existing water risk indicators. Deliver internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the broader team's understanding of climate risk and disclosure requirements. Requirements: Mandatory assurance experience: Hands-on experience in sustainability or climate assurance at a Big Four firm, ideally within a Climate Change and Sustainability Services practice, including CSRD/ESRS or climate-related assurance engagements. Candidates must understand the evidence, controls, and documentation required to successfully support a limited-assurance review. This is a non-negotiable requirement. Bachelor's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or PhD in Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Geosciences, or a related field is also expected. At least 7 years of senior-level experience in climate risk and resilience assessment, corporate sustainability, climate disclosure consulting, or sustainability assurance. Demonstrated experience leading or owning climate risk, sustainability reporting, or CSRD-related engagements from beginning to end. Strong working knowledge of climate-related financial disclosure frameworks, particularly IFRS S2, together with familiarity with CSRD and ESRS requirements. Experience working with physical and transition climate risk scenarios and datasets, including NGFS scenarios, IEA pathways, carbon price trajectories, and sector decarbonization pathways such as SBTi and TPI. Understanding of how climate scenarios translate into financial impacts, including the ability to assess potential costs and business exposure. Experience integrating climate risk considerations into enterprise risk management systems and corporate disclosure frameworks.

Collaborate with the client's team to analyze, reverse-engineer, and document critical business workflows and user scenarios. Introduce basic automated checks for selected business workflows and APIs, working alongside engineers and using AI-assisted tools where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and collaborate with stakeholders to validate business requirements. Investigate test failures, application logs, and stack traces to identify potential defects and communicate findings effectively. Work closely with developers and the Product Owner to clarify requirements, investigate unexpected application behavior, and resolve quality-related issues. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in Manual QA or Software Testing, primarily focused on web applications or backend systems. Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals, methodologies, and test design techniques. Practical experience designing, executing, and maintaining regression test suites, smoke tests, sanity checks, and release validation criteria. Ability to independently analyze business workflows, identify potential risks, and translate functional requirements into comprehensive test cases and scenarios. Hands-on experience with exploratory testing and API testing. Good understanding of HTTP fundamentals, cookies, sessions, and typical web application architecture. Practical experience using API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or curl. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps (ADO), including executing existing pipeline jobs, reviewing results, and investigating failures. Basic familiarity with application logs, stack traces, and build tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to identifying and investigating defects. Good communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Upper-Intermediate or higher English proficiency. Nice to Have: Basic experience with test automation or a strong willingness to learn and introduce simple automated checks using AI-assisted tools. Familiarity with Java-based testing tools and frameworks, including JUnit, TestNG, Selenium, Selenide, or REST Assured. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to generate basic test scripts or test skeletons, with the ability to review, validate, and refine generated code. Previous experience testing applications during framework upgrades, platform modernization, or backend migrations. Familiarity with characterization testing, golden master testing, or other techniques for comparing application behavior before and after system changes. Experience working with legacy Java applications, Apache Tomcat, or servlet-based systems. Familiarity with XML, XSLT, or server-side rendering technologies. Basic understanding of application security principles and common OWASP vulnerabilities. jobs.title: 3D Artist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Create high-quality 3D vehicle models for a mobile racing game. Model automotive tuning and customization components, including body kits, bumpers, spoilers, hoods, wheels, and other vehicle parts. Produce both Low Poly and High Poly models, including UV mapping and texture baking. Develop PBR materials and textures that align with the game's artistic direction and visual requirements. Optimize geometry, textures, materials, and assets to ensure smooth performance on mobile devices. Prepare and integrate 3D assets into Unity, including prefab creation and material and shader configuration. Incorporate AI-powered tools into the 3D production pipeline to generate visual references, prototype ideas, support modeling and texturing, and improve workflow efficiency. Collaborate closely with artists and game designers to maintain visual consistency and achieve the desired level of quality. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Self-Serve
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own and optimize the complete self-serve funnel, defining, measuring, and improving each stage, including signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and customer expansion. Act as the product owner for the website and application interface, setting the roadmap, defining priorities, and driving improvements to the overall user experience. Collaborate closely with engineering leads, developers, and designers to deliver product and website enhancements that capture demand and increase funnel performance. Design and run conversion experiments, including A/B tests, while partnering with design and product marketing teams to refine messaging, content, formats, and user journeys. Improve product-led growth journeys originating in developer communities, open-source projects, and emerging AI agent ecosystems. Develop a deep understanding of developer workflows, including documentation, SDKs, code examples, and the initial hands-on product experience, to remove friction and encourage adoption. Build intelligent customer data and segmentation approaches using product usage signals and firmographic information to support personalized onboarding, relevant content, and customer nurturing. Work with Revenue Operations to identify product-qualified leads and determine when sales engagement can help convert or expand customer relationships. Establish a rigorous experimentation culture by developing hypotheses, launching tests, evaluating results, and scaling successful initiatives while discontinuing ineffective approaches. Track and report key growth indicators, including signup-to-activation rates, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion revenue, funnel velocity, and the quality of leads passed to sales. Align marketing, product, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared acquisition and growth objectives. Requirements: 5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel optimization roles. Proven success driving customer acquisition and managing growth funnels within B2B SaaS, developer-focused businesses, or companies with self-serve and product-led growth (PLG) models. Strong understanding of how developers discover, evaluate, adopt, and use technical products, with experience marketing or building solutions for technical audiences. Previous experience with developer tools, APIs, data products, or other technical platforms. Demonstrated ability to turn websites into effective demand-generation and conversion channels, with direct ownership of conversion performance rather than traffic alone. Track record of improving customer activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion revenue, and customer retention while reducing churn. Strong analytical and data-driven approach, including defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting users, and combining product usage signals with targeted messaging and sales engagement. Experience as a Product Owner or Growth Product Manager, working closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver improvements iteratively. Practical experience using AI coding tools to prototype ideas, build mockups, and create working demos independently. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align product, marketing, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared goals. Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and how they are changing developer workflows, product discovery, and buying behavior. Production coding experience or contributions to open-source projects are considered an advantage. Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4, as well as marketing automation and CRM systems, is a plus. Experience developing product-qualified lead (PQL) strategies or platform-to-enterprise upgrade journeys is desirable. Benefits: Fully remote working e

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist – Applied ML & GenAI
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead model selection, feature engineering, and evaluation strategies across client projects and engagements. Translate business challenges into well-defined data science problems, establishing success metrics, data requirements, and robust validation methodologies. Develop, deploy, and maintain machine-learning models throughout their lifecycle, from initial experimentation to production monitoring and retraining. Monitor model performance, identify data and model drift, and implement appropriate improvements to maintain reliability and accuracy. Design reusable modelling approaches and frameworks that can be adapted across different industries and business contexts. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities into solutions where relevant. Lead client discovery sessions, technical workshops, and presentations, communicating recommendations effectively to technical teams and senior stakeholders. Establish and promote best practices for model quality, reproducibility, responsible AI, and engineering standards. Mentor junior data scientists, support their technical development, and produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation. Collaborate with leadership and product development teams to align modelling initiatives with platform objectives and client needs. Requirements: At least 6 years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with a proven track record of developing and deploying production-ready solutions using Python. Strong applied statistics expertise, including Bayesian inference, time-series forecasting, and causal inference. Advanced knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, bias-variance trade-offs, and model or data drift detection. Solid software engineering skills, including typed Python, pytest, and SQL, particularly with PostgreSQL. Familiarity with columnar databases such as ClickHouse is an advantage. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain, justify, and defend modelling decisions and results to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Good understanding of data governance, information security, and regulatory compliance in client-facing environments. Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, and RAG architectures, including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning, is highly desirable. Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, FAISS, or Azure AI Search is an advantage. Experience with service ownership and deployment technologies such as FastAPI, CI/CD pipelines, and schema migrations is beneficial. Knowledge of causal and Bayesian tools such as DoWhy, PyMC, and statsmodels, as well as bandits or sequential decision-making approaches, is a plus. Previous experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector is highly valued. Strong analytical thinking, autonomy, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively with international teams and clients. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Opportunity to shape the core intelligence and modelling capabilities of an advanced AI-powered platform. Exposure to diverse business challenges and real-world projects across seven industries. End-to-end ownership of machine-learning solutions, from problem definition and experimentation through to production deployment and monitoring. Collaboration with an international, AI-focused team and opportunities to engage with global clients. Senior-level technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence modelling standards, solution architecture, and responsible AI practices. Flexible remote environment offering opportunities for professional growth and meaningful technical impact.

Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities into solutions where relevant. Lead client discovery sessions, technical workshops, and presentations, communicating recommendations effectively to technical teams and senior stakeholders. Establish and promote best practices for model quality, reproducibility, responsible AI, and engineering standards. Mentor junior data scientists, support their technical development, and produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation. Collaborate with leadership and product development teams to align modelling initiatives with platform objectives and client needs. Requirements: At least 6 years of professional experience in data science or applied machine learning, with a proven track record of developing and deploying production-ready solutions using Python. Strong applied statistics expertise, including Bayesian inference, time-series forecasting, and causal inference. Advanced knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, bias-variance trade-offs, and model or data drift detection. Solid software engineering skills, including typed Python, pytest, and SQL, particularly with PostgreSQL. Familiarity with columnar databases such as ClickHouse is an advantage. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain, justify, and defend modelling decisions and results to non-technical audiences and executive stakeholders. Good understanding of data governance, information security, and regulatory compliance in client-facing environments. Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, and RAG architectures, including prompt engineering and model fine-tuning, is highly desirable. Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, FAISS, or Azure AI Search is an advantage. Experience with service ownership and deployment technologies such as FastAPI, CI/CD pipelines, and schema migrations is beneficial. Knowledge of causal and Bayesian tools such as DoWhy, PyMC, and statsmodels, as well as bandits or sequential decision-making approaches, is a plus. Previous experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector is highly valued. Strong analytical thinking, autonomy, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively with international teams and clients. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Opportunity to shape the core intelligence and modelling capabilities of an advanced AI-powered platform. Exposure to diverse business challenges and real-world projects across seven industries. End-to-end ownership of machine-learning solutions, from problem definition and experimentation through to production deployment and monitoring. Collaboration with an international, AI-focused team and opportunities to engage with global clients. Senior-level technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence modelling standards, solution architecture, and responsible AI practices. Flexible remote environment offering opportunities for professional growth and meaningful technical impact.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop, implement, and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure. Build and improve model components, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and numerical computing methods. Create reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools. Design, solve, review, and validate challenging machine-learning engineering tasks, ensuring solutions meet defined technical and performance requirements. Optimize model performance, memory usage, throughput, and computational efficiency. Investigate and resolve numerical, software, and system-level issues affecting model training or inference. Assess implementations for correctness, reliability, reproducibility, and alignment with project specifications. Requirements: BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning and practical ML engineering. Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience using coding agents. Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the following areas: inference and serving, model evaluation, data and feature engineering, retrieval/ranking/RAG, MLOps, model compression and optimization, or GPU/kernel optimization. Ability to develop, debug, and assess complex technical implementations independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to technical accuracy and measurable outcomes. Experience in a recognized technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or established engineering environment is highly desirable. Exceptional academic contributions or open-source engineering experience may also be considered. Availability to begin promptly, with the ability to start the first task within 24–48 hours after completing onboarding if selected. Benefits: Competitive hourly compensation ranging from $60 to $120, depending on expertise and project requirements. Fully remote contractor opportunity, open to candidates globally. Flexible working arrangements, with the freedom to choose your working hours and days, including weekends. Part-time commitment of approximately 15 hours per week. Output-based compensation: payment is provided for tasks that meet the established project specifications, with task duration varying according to complexity and individual workflow. Opportunity to work on advanced AI training initiatives and challenging machine-learning engineering problems. Potential for a fast hiring process, with roles typically filled within approximately 48 hours. Opportunity to contribute independently while applying specialized technical knowledge to impactful AI development work.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent (Spanish & English)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Customer Support Agent, you will manage a wide range of customer requests while ensuring accurate transactions, effective issue resolution, and consistently high service standards. You will also contribute to improving support operations and delivering a seamless customer experience. Respond to customer enquiries through multiple channels, including email and live chat, ensuring timely, accurate, and helpful responses. Investigate and resolve account and transaction issues, including failed buyouts, stuck casino rounds, and other gaming-related incidents. Handle manual credit tickets and cash transactions, ensuring accuracy and appropriate processing. Assess customer situations and process compensations when necessary, following established procedures. Support localization initiatives and translation activities to ensure clear and accurate communication for Spanish-speaking and other European customers. Regularly update FAQ content and support documentation to address recurring customer questions and improve self-service resources. Conduct quality checks and identify opportunities to enhance customer support processes and operational efficiency. Optimize the use of existing customer support tools to improve response times and service quality. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex issues and ensure compliance with applicable European regulatory requirements. Contribute to continuous improvements in the overall customer experience and customer satisfaction. Requirements: The ideal candidate has previous customer support experience in the online gambling industry, strong knowledge of poker, and excellent communication skills in both Spanish and English. You should be comfortable handling sensitive transactions, managing multiple requests, and making sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Proven experience in customer support within the gambling or online gaming industry. In-depth knowledge of poker and a genuine passion for the game. Fluency in both Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers. Experience handling customer complaints, troubleshooting issues, and resolving transaction-related problems. Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing manual credits, cash transactions, and customer compensations. Ability to multitask, prioritize requests, and make effective decisions under pressure. A customer-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Flexibility to work across European time zones, including evenings and weekends when required. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with international teams. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere within the eligible European region. Full-time employment opportunities across Europe. Uncapped performance-based bonuses for top-performing employees. Quarterly performance reviews with opportunities for additional bonuses. Company-funded technology and home office setup budget. Monthly dedicated learning and development hours to support professional growth. Opportunities to attend industry conferences and professional events. Company meet-ups and opportunities to connect with colleagues in person. Dynamic international working environment with opportunities to develop industry expertise.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director (Part-time)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will be responsible for driving commercial performance across strategic accounts while developing the people, processes, and systems needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. Own customer revenue, retention, and account expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts. Identify commercial opportunities, customer risks, and early churn indicators, translating insights into proactive retention and growth strategies. Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the organization as a strategic business partner. Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial negotiations, and major customer escalations. Ensure every strategic account has clear objectives, defined ownership, measurable health indicators, and a structured customer success plan. Lead, coach, and develop Customer Success Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement. Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments. Leverage CRM platforms, data analytics, and AI-powered automation to improve operational visibility and reduce administrative workloads. Represent the voice of the customer by translating feedback and insights into product, commercial, and operational improvements. Establish performance practices that help the team identify revenue opportunities and customer risks early while strengthening executive relationships. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced commercial and customer success leader with a strong record of growing strategic accounts, improving retention, and developing high-performing teams. You should combine excellent relationship-building abilities with analytical thinking, commercial awareness, and the confidence to lead in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment. 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a similar commercial leadership position. Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and account expansion. Significant experience managing high-value or enterprise accounts and building relationships with senior decision-makers. Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with the ability to translate customer data and business insights into actionable strategies. A proactive ownership mentality and the ability to adapt quickly when priorities change. Experience using CRM systems or Customer Success management platforms is an advantage. Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success. Ability to balance strategic leadership responsibilities with hands-on account management in a part-time capacity. jobs.title: Lead Creative (Motion Design)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As the Lead Creative (Motion Design), you will oversee creative strategy, team development, and project execution while ensuring exceptional results for clients. You will foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, balancing creative ambition with operational excellence. Lead, inspire, and develop a team of motion designers, driving creative excellence and innovation across projects. Define and own creative strategies, workflows, and project delivery, ensuring high-quality outputs within agreed timelines and budgets. Collaborate closely with dedicated account teams to strengthen customer relationships and support long-term client growth. Partner directly with global brands, presenting creative concepts, providing strategic direction, and building trust through outstanding creative work. Mentor team members, supporting their professional development, technical skills, and creative growth. Champion the adoption of emerging tools and technologies, particularly AI-powered solutions, to improve motion design workflows and creative outputs. Oversee multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining consistency, attention to detail, and exceptional production standards. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong creative vision, extensive motion design expertise, and proven leadership experience. You should be comfortable managing international creative teams, working directly with clients, and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. Bachelor's degree or higher in Design, Creative Arts, Communications, or a related field. At least 6 years of experience as a creative lead within a leading international creative agency or an in-house design team at a global technology company. A strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding motion design, animation, and creative direction capabilities. Proven experience leading high-performing creative teams and managing end-to-end creative projects. Advanced expertise in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro, with strong animation and video editing skills. Solid understanding of AI-assisted design and motion workflows, including tools such as Midjourney, Runway, and Krea. Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into creative pipelines to enhance ideation, production, and delivery. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to quickly learn new processes and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent ability to deliver pixel-perfect creative work on time and within budget. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. A proactive, customer-centric mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Benefits: Fully remote work environment, with the flexibility to work from different locations worldwide. Opportunity to collaborate with an international team representing more than 60 nationalities. Exposure to leading global brands and diverse creative projects. High-trust, performance-driven culture that encourages direct feedback, continuous learning, and collaboration. Opportunities to influence creative strategy, contribute ideas, and shape the future of a growing global business. Access to mentorship, professional development, and meaningful leadership responsibilities. Opportunity to work with innovative creative technologies and help advance AI-powered design and production workflows. Inclusive and collaborative environment that values diversity, equal opportunities, and individual contributions.

jobs.title: Construction Back-Office & Project Coordination Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will take responsibility for keeping construction projects and administrative workflows organized, ensuring that tasks are completed on time, communication remains clear, and financial and project records are accurate. Task Management and Follow-Through Convert meeting notes and job-walk summaries into clear, actionable task lists. Assign tasks to the appropriate team members, establish deadlines, and clarify responsibilities with the owner when necessary. Create, organize, and track project tasks in Buildertrend. Follow up on outstanding tasks until they are completed, rather than simply forwarding requests. Review open tasks with the owner and team daily, identifying delays, blockers, and missed deadlines. Escalate issues promptly to keep projects moving forward. Subcontractor, Team, and Client Communication Send task updates and project communications to subcontractors and internal team members. Use Buildertrend messaging and email features to maintain organized, traceable project communication. Contact subcontractors and colleagues by phone when direct follow-up is required. Coordinate schedules, inspections, and service calls. Communicate with clients through email and text, keeping client conversations separate from Buildertrend. Organize communication records by project for easy reference. Bookkeeping Support and Financial Tracking Enter bills and invoices into Buildertrend and QuickBooks. Maintain Excel trackers and cash flow reports as payments, checks, and invoices are received. Prepare client invoices using established Excel templates. Keep accounting records current and ensure transactions are recorded promptly. Coordinate with the bookkeeper regarding financial records, documentation, and questions. Document and Administrative Support Prepare, format, and edit proposals and other business documents using Microsoft Word. Save and organize incoming and outgoing documents for accurate recordkeeping. Maintain organized email correspondence and project files. Handle routine administrative requests from the owner, business partner, and supervisor. Buildertrend Administration and Process Improvement Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information in Buildertrend. Support improvements in the use of Buildertrend for project communication, task tracking, and coordination. Learn and apply new platform features using available training resources. Identify opportunities to make administrative processes more efficient, consistent, and reliable. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced executive assistant, construction administrator, or operations support professional with strong organizational skills and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities. You should be confident communicating with different stakeholders, comfortable working with financial and project management tools, and persistent in following tasks through to completion. Previous experience in executive assistance, construction administration, or operations support is required. Working knowledge of Buildertrend is required; candidates must be comfortable using the platform and learning additional features. Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including maintaining trackers and preparing reports. Excellent written and spoken English, with a native or near-native level of fluency and communication ability. Strong phone, email, and text communication skills. Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and time management. Demonstrated ability to follow up consistently and take ownership of tasks until they are closed. Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships simultaneously. Proactive problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify potential delays and raise concerns early. Dependability, initiative, and the ability to work effectively with a fast-paced, demanding business owner. Comfortable working independently while remaining responsive to instructions and priorities. Preferred Qualific

jobs.title: Lead Generation & Growth Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will own the planning, execution, and optimization of lead-generation and growth marketing initiatives, ensuring that marketing activities translate into qualified prospects, stronger conversion rates, and measurable business opportunities. Develop and execute multi-channel lead-generation strategies to attract qualified prospects, increase conversions, and support business growth. Manage and optimize the complete lead-generation funnel, from traffic acquisition and lead capture to MQLs, SQLs, and sales opportunities. Take ownership of marketing initiatives from market research and strategy development through campaign planning, execution, testing, analysis, and optimization. Lead organic-first, multi-channel marketing programmes, coordinating SEO, PPC, content, design, and development specialists to achieve campaign objectives. Identify new growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, audience insights, and marketing performance data. Monitor and report on funnel performance, including website traffic, landing-page engagement, lead nurturing, qualification, and conversion. Plan and execute conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives to improve campaign effectiveness and lead-generation results. Improve website performance, organic visibility, user experience, and conversion rates through hands-on optimization and collaboration with relevant specialists. Support outbound marketing and account-based marketing initiatives in partnership with Sales and Business Development. jobs.title: Business Analyst – Master & Reference Data Management (MDM/RDM)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Take ownership of an existing Master Data Management proof of concept, coordinate knowledge transfer, identify outstanding requirements, and drive the solution through final implementation. Ensure requirements traceability, documentation, and testing comply with corporate Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards. Assess enterprise demand for Reference Data Management and collaborate with architecture teams to identify suitable long-term approaches. Strong practical understanding of Master Data Management concepts, including data models, matching and merging rules, deduplication, and golden records. Experience translating complex business processes across multiple systems into data definitions, mappings, and testable functional requirements. Proven ability to take ownership of an existing initiative and drive it through implementation, testing, and operational handover. Strong stakeholder-management, cross-functional coordination, and requirements-documentation skills. Experience working with structured SDLC delivery processes and conducting functional testing and UAT. Nice-to-have qualifications: Hands-on familiarity with Informatica MDM capabilities and configuration concepts. Work arrangement: Fully remote within Europe. Start date: ASAP, with immediate availability preferred. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst – External Data Transfer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own the intake, planning, coordination, and successful execution of external data-transfer requests. Lead requirements discussions with scientists, Business Technology Partners (BTPs), external vendors, and technical teams. Consolidate previously fragmented transfer activities into a consistent, centrally managed operating model. Establish standardized, Jira-based processes for request intake, tracking, and documentation. Requirements At least 5 years of experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Technical Delivery Lead. Demonstrated ownership of cross-functional technical delivery involving multiple stakeholders. Experience coordinating technical engineers or analysts and prioritizing their activities. Working knowledge of file-transfer approaches such as MFT/MLFT, SFTP, or comparable managed transfer mechanisms. Familiarity with cloud storage technologies, particularly AWS S3. Ability to understand data-integrity validation methods, including checksums and file manifests. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders and external technical partners. Nice-to-have qualifications: Direct experience with Globus or Science Exchange. Background in scientific research, pharmaceutical R&D, or external laboratory data transfers. Experience with GxP/GLP data integrity and regulated delivery environments. Familiarity with Aravo third-party risk assessment processes. Experience designing Jira-based intake workflows and standardizing services. Previous experience working with MSD/Merck. Benefits Engagement type: Freelance / contract. Work arrangement: Fully remote within Europe. Start date: ASAP, with immediate availability preferred. Project environment: Opportunity to support a global pharmaceutical organization and contribute to the development of a standardized enterprise data-transfer capability.

jobs.title: Product Manager – AI-First EdTech (PO / Technical BA welcome)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, actionable, development-ready tickets. Leverage AI tools to streamline product workflows, including drafting requirements, analyzing data, and improving documentation while maintaining high-quality outputs. Build clickable prototypes using AI-powered coding tools to test concepts, validate solutions, and gather feedback before development begins. Own and maintain a well-organized, prioritized product backlog and ensure the product roadmap remains accurate and aligned with business objectives. Define clear acceptance criteria and conduct feature acceptance testing to verify that deliverables meet requirements before release. Work closely with developers and QA specialists throughout the development lifecycle to coordinate implementation, testing, and successful releases. Analyze customer feedback and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities and guide future product decisions. Maintain accurate and up-to-date product documentation to ensure alignment and effective communication across stakeholders and technical teams. Experience owning or conducting acceptance testing to ensure product features meet expectations before release. Daily, practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, or similar solutions to improve productivity and support product-related tasks. Strong curiosity and willingness to explore new AI capabilities, particularly AI-assisted development and rapid prototyping. Experience working in Agile development environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an international remote environment. Nice to have: Ability to read, understand, and make basic modifications to HTML, CSS, or React. Nice to have: Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), EdTech platforms, or continuing education products. Nice to have: Background in healthcare or another regulated industry. Long-term professional opportunity within an innovative, AI-first product development environment. Opportunity to work on a meaningful product that helps healthcare professionals maintain their knowledge, skills, and professional certifications. Collaboration with an experienced, cross-functional international development team. Room for professional growth and continuous learning as AI transforms the product management landscape.
