jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Execute comprehensive manual regression test cycles on iOS and Android release candidates across a range of supported devices and operating systems. Identify, document, and report bugs with clear reproduction steps, environment details, relevant logs, and severity assessments. Conduct exploratory testing on new features and user journeys to uncover edge cases and potential issues not detected by automated testing. Triage incoming bugs from internal testing, production incidents, and user feedback channels, prioritizing issues according to their impact and severity. Collaborate with developers and release managers throughout release candidate cycles to verify fixes, resolve blockers, and support release decisions. Create, maintain, and expand manual testing documentation, including test cases, checklists, and regression matrices within test management platforms. Perform release-day validation, including smoke testing on production builds and post-release monitoring to ensure product stability. Contribute to improving QA processes, testing consistency, and communication across distributed teams. Requirements: 3–5 years of hands-on manual QA experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android. Strong attention to detail, proactivity, and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality products. Proven experience writing structured and actionable bug reports, including reproduction rates, device and OS information, logs, and severity classifications. Experience managing or supporting complete regression testing cycles within scheduled release environments. Strong exploratory testing capabilities, including session-based, risk-prioritized, and well-documented testing approaches. Familiarity with test management and bug-tracking tools such as TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, Jira, Shortcut, or Notion. Experience conducting real-device testing through BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar platforms. Excellent written English and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across international time zones. Availability to overlap with Central European Time (CET) business hours for at least four hours per day. Eligibility to work in the country of residence. Nice to have: Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, WebdriverIO, or Appium. Nice to have: Basic proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, or Go. Nice to have: Previous experience testing cryptocurrency wallets, DeFi platforms, fintech applications, or products handling sensitive financial and user data. Nice to have: Exposure to containerized or cloud-based testing infrastructure and browser extension testing across Chrome, Firefox, or Brave. Nice to have: Familiarity with log and network inspection tools such as Charles Proxy, Xcode Instruments, and Android Studio Logcat. Nice to have: Understanding of release management workflows and release candidate gating processes. Benefits: Competitive salary and benefits package. Fully remote working environment with flexible working hours. Opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals from diverse international backgrounds. Excellent learning, professional development, and career growth opportunities. Exposure to fast-paced, challenging, and innovative projects within the blockchain and Web3 ecosystem. Opportunity to contribute to products shaping the future of decentralized finance and digital asset management. International and collaborative working environment with a relatively flat organizational structure. Flexibility to work remotely from an eligible country, with the ability to collaborate across global teams.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Freelance - B2B)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Identify, research, and generate new B2B business opportunities across international markets and multiple industry sectors. Proactively approach companies with current or anticipated recruitment, staffing, and talent acquisition needs. Develop commercial opportunities across sectors including Hospitality, iGaming, Fintech, E-Mobility, Healthcare, Finance and Accounting, Technology, BPO, and other relevant industries. Leverage your existing professional network, industry relationships, and business development experience to introduce potential clients and generate qualified leads. Identify and engage key decision-makers, including HR Directors, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Hiring Managers, and senior executives. Initiate commercial conversations, present recruitment and staffing solutions, and communicate the value of potential partnerships. Qualify prospective clients by understanding their recruitment requirements, hiring volumes, business objectives, and potential collaboration opportunities. Facilitate introductions between qualified prospects and the internal recruitment team to support the development and conversion of commercial opportunities. Build, manage, and continuously develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients across different industries and geographical markets. Establish and nurture long-term business relationships to create recurring commercial opportunities and sustainable revenue streams. Independently define and execute outreach strategies, target markets, prospecting activities, and business development priorities. Monitor market opportunities and industry developments to identify potential clients and expand commercial reach. Collaborate with internal recruitment and delivery teams to ensure a smooth transition from initial client engagement to successful commercial partnerships. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in B2B Business Development, Sales, Lead Generation, or a related commercial role. Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, prospecting methodologies, lead qualification, and relationship management. An established professional network or direct access to business decision-makers within one or more relevant industries is a significant advantage. Previous experience identifying new business opportunities and developing commercial relationships across international markets. Confidence in approaching companies, presenting business propositions, and initiating discussions with senior decision-makers. Excellent communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify client needs and translate them into potential business opportunities. Entrepreneurial mindset, with a proactive and results-oriented approach to generating new business. Ability to work independently, manage your own prospecting activities, and take full ownership of business development objectives. Strong organizational and pipeline management skills, with the ability to prioritize opportunities and maintain consistent outreach. Professional proficiency in English is essential. Additional languages are highly valued. Comfortable working under a fully commission-based freelance arrangement without a fixed salary. Self-motivated and commercially driven, with the ability to build a long-term independent business development partnership. Previous experience in recruitment, staffing, HR services, or talent acquisition is beneficial. Flexibility and adaptability to work across different industries, markets, and international business environments. Benefits: Fully remote freelance collaboration, open to professionals based anywhere in the world. Complete working flexibility, allowing you to determine your own schedule, geographical markets, target industries, and outreach strategy. Attractive uncapped commission structure, with commission terms agreed in advance for successfully converted client leads. Unlimited earning po

jobs.title: SMS Routing Specialist / Telecom Traffic Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Identify, research, test, and evaluate SMS A2P routes that meet customer requirements, including A2P and OTP traffic delivery. Expand the global SMS supplier network by identifying suitable providers and supporting supplier evaluation and onboarding. Monitor and analyse traffic quality using key performance indicators such as delivery receipt rates (DLR), conversion rates, and delivery speed. Evaluate the price-to-quality ratio of existing and potential routes to ensure competitive and reliable service. Optimise existing routing strategies to reduce delivery costs, improve margins, and maintain traffic quality. Prepare regular reports on route performance, traffic quality, and operational statistics. Use Excel to analyse traffic data, build reports, create pivot tables, and identify performance trends and improvement opportunities. Develop commercial proposals that reflect customer requirements, pricing expectations, and available routing options. Apply market knowledge and commercial judgment to support supplier negotiations and improve the competitiveness of the SMS offering. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional experience in the A2P SMS industry is essential. Proven experience identifying, evaluating, and onboarding SMS suppliers is essential. Strong understanding of SMS traffic management and routing, including experience with iGaming traffic. Good knowledge of global SMS markets, supplier dynamics, pricing structures, and commercial trends. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess route performance, interpret traffic statistics, and evaluate cost and quality. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including reporting, pivot tables, and statistical analysis. Strong negotiation and commercial skills, with the ability to assess supplier offers and develop competitive proposals. Fluent English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, internationally focused team. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive compensation package. International exposure: Opportunity to work with a global team and gain experience across international telecommunications markets. Professional development: Build and deepen expertise in the fast-growing A2P SMS and telecom routing industry. High-impact responsibilities: Direct contribution to revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier network expansion, and business performance. Dynamic environment: Join an energetic, fast-paced organisation experiencing significant growth and transformation. Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues in an international and supportive team. Opportunity to make an impact: Help shape routing strategies and contribute to the development of the global messaging ecosystem.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Strategist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Bring performance data, campaign insights, and historical results into the strategic briefing process to ensure creative decisions are grounded in audience behaviour and evidence. Lead performance-focused projects by identifying opportunities in the data, defining strategic direction, and briefing creative teams. Translate campaign concepts into actionable in-market plans across channels, formats, and audience segments. Design creative testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, including test planning and tracking requirements. Analyse creative performance to understand what is working, what is underperforming, and the reasons behind campaign outcomes. Drive ongoing creative optimisation by scaling successful concepts, improving underperforming assets, and supporting audience progression through the marketing funnel. Turn performance results into clear recommendations on what to scale, stop, or test next. Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, presenting insights, performance results, and recommendations with confidence. Identify opportunities for account growth through continuous optimisation programmes and new performance-focused offerings. Apply an AI-native mindset throughout the strategic process, exploring ways to improve analysis, creative development, and operational workflows. Partner with the product team to develop new performance creative solutions, scalable workflows, and offerings that extend beyond existing tools and capabilities. Share insights and best practices across teams, helping strengthen the connection between creative strategy and performance outcomes. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in performance or growth strategy within an agency or brand environment, with a strong focus on performance creative. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex performance strategy engagements and influence senior client stakeholders and creative leaders. Proven experience designing and managing creative testing programmes that have delivered measurable performance improvements. Strong analytical capabilities across major advertising platforms, with a working understanding of attribution, measurement, and campaign performance. Full-funnel experience spanning paid social, customer acquisition, and conversion. Ability to identify creative opportunities through data analysis and translate insights into clear, actionable briefs that inspire creative teams. Strong understanding of how brand-building and performance marketing complement one another. Genuine curiosity about emerging technologies, with experience experimenting with or developing new tools, processes, or workflows. Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience advising and presenting recommendations directly to senior clients. A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuously developing strategic expertise. Benefits: Remote-first work environment: Fully remote company culture, with the flexibility to collaborate across time zones. Global team: Opportunity to work alongside colleagues from more than 60 nationalities and across diverse cultures and disciplines. Meaningful impact: Contribute to work for ambitious global brands and help shape the future of performance creative. High-trust culture: Fast-paced environment built around direct feedback, collaboration, continuous learning, and low-ego teamwork. Career development: Access to mentorship, meaningful responsibility, and opportunities to grow professionally and take on leadership challenges. Opportunity to influence: Join a growing organisation where individual ideas and contributions can shape new services, workflows, and strategic direction.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own customer revenue, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts, ensuring commercial objectives and customer outcomes remain aligned. Proactively identify growth opportunities, customer risks, and early churn signals, translating insights into clear actions and measurable results. Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the business as a strategic partner rather than simply a service provider. Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial discussions, and major customer escalations. Ensure each strategic account has clearly defined objectives, accountable owners, customer health indicators, and a structured success plan. Lead, coach, and develop the Customer Success team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance. Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments. Design and implement scalable Customer Success processes covering onboarding, account health, reporting, customer lifecycle management, and churn prevention. Leverage CRM systems, data, and AI-powered automation to improve visibility, streamline workflows, and allow the team to focus on high-value customer interactions. Act as the voice of the customer, bringing feedback and insights into product development, commercial strategy, and operational priorities. Requirements: 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a comparable commercial leadership role. Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and/or account expansion. Demonstrated experience managing high-value or enterprise customers and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers. Previous people leadership experience, including the ability to coach, challenge, motivate, and develop high-performing teams. Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret account performance, identify opportunities, and address customer risks. Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills. A strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change. Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms, along with an interest in AI, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success. Candidates who do not meet every listed preference are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience and the ability to make an impact. Benefits: Work arrangement: Fully remote, with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Employment type: Part-time leadership opportunity. Strategic ownership: Direct responsibility for customer revenue, retention, account growth, and team performance. Opportunity to shape the function: Play a central role in defining and developing the Customer Success strategy and operating model as the organization grows. AI-first environment: Work within a business built around seven specialized AI agents, with data and automation integrated into everyday operations. Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with teams across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation.

jobs.title: NLP Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Language Model Development: Train, fine-tune, and improve language models used in AI-powered conversational assistants and copilots. Adapt models to new conversation scenarios, response requirements, and structured output formats. Dataset Preparation and Management: Build, prepare, and maintain high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Identify data gaps, analyze model errors, define annotation requirements, and review annotated examples to improve model performance. Model Selection and Prompt Engineering: Evaluate and compare internally hosted language models with external model APIs, assessing response quality, latency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs. Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements. Model Deployment and API Development: Build, package, and maintain services and APIs around language models using FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications. Inference Optimization: Improve model inference speed, GPU memory utilization, and serving costs while maintaining the required response quality and performance standards. Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary. Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences. Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks. Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation. Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA. Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention. Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance. Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review. Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches. Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation. Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure. Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies. Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures. Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes. SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data. English proficiency sufficient to understand technical documentation, research papers, and communicate te

jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Machine Learning Development: Design, develop, and implement machine learning solutions from initial concept and experimentation through to production deployment. LLM Training and Fine-Tuning: Train, fine-tune, and integrate Large Language Models, applying practical knowledge of transformer architectures and modern model adaptation techniques. AI Feature Development: Build and integrate intelligent, AI-powered features into real-world applications, ensuring they deliver practical value and an effective user experience. Production Deployment: Deploy, scale, and monitor LLM-powered functionalities in production environments, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability. Model Optimization: Explore opportunities to improve model performance, efficiency, and inference capabilities through appropriate optimization techniques. Data Management: Work with machine learning datasets and data processing tools to prepare, manipulate, and manage data for model training and evaluation. Machine Learning Fundamentals: Strong theoretical understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, including the underlying principles of algorithms, architectures, and model behavior. LLM Expertise: Practical experience training and fine-tuning Large Language Models, with a solid understanding of transformer architectures and their applications. Python Development: Strong production-level Python programming skills and experience developing reliable, scalable software solutions. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Object-Oriented Design (OOD), and Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). LLM Frameworks: Familiarity with modern machine learning and LLM integration frameworks, such as Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, and LangChain. Data Processing: Experience working with machine learning data pipelines and data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. Research and Documentation: Strong analytical and research capabilities, combined with excellent technical writing and documentation skills. Communication and Collaboration: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams. Problem-Solving: A structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting, experimentation, and developing solutions to complex technical challenges. Continuous Learning: Genuine interest in emerging AI technologies, machine learning research, and the ongoing evolution of LLM capabilities. Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience deploying and maintaining LLM-powered features in production environments. Knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT. Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector databases such as Pinecone and Weaviate. Understanding of model serving and inference optimization techniques, including quantization and batching. Exposure to MLOps practices, including model monitoring, version control, and CI/

jobs.title: Email & CRM Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Management: Plan, build, execute, and optimize multi-channel CRM campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging to strengthen customer engagement, activation, and retention. Lifecycle Marketing: Develop and manage communication strategies for existing customers, creating relevant touchpoints throughout the customer journey. Customer Segmentation and Personalization: Analyze customer behavior and segment databases to deliver targeted, personalized communications based on user preferences, activity, and engagement patterns across different markets. Testing and Optimization: Continuously conduct A/B tests and experiments involving messaging, copywriting, design, audience segments, timing, and communication channels to improve campaign effectiveness. Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Track and analyze key marketing performance indicators, including open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and retention metrics. Prepare regular performance reports and recommend actionable improvements. Deliverability Management: Monitor email deliverability, maintain sender reputation, and implement best practices to ensure successful campaign delivery. CRM Platform Management: Use Customer.io and other customer engagement technologies to manage automated workflows, campaign execution, audience segmentation, and lifecycle communications. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about digital marketing trends, emerging technologies, and AI-powered marketing solutions to identify opportunities for innovation and improved campaign performance. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience as a CRM Manager, Email Marketing Manager, or in a similar B2C CRM marketing position. Previous experience in the iGaming industry is considered a strong advantage. Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics and customer engagement indicators across the entire customer lifecycle. Hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms, preferably Customer.io, and the ability to manage automated campaigns and communication workflows. Good understanding of customer segmentation, audience targeting, logical operators, and personalized communication strategies. Strong technical knowledge of HTML and APIs, with the ability to support CRM integrations and campaign implementation. Experience planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging. Ability to analyze campaign performance data, identify improvement opportunities, and translate insights into effective marketing actions. Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and sender reputation management. A customer-centric and results-oriented mindset, with a strong focus on engagement, retention, and continuous optimization. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, combined with attention to detail. jobs.title: Middle Software Engineer - Backend (Platform)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As part of the backend engineering team, you will develop and maintain scalable services while contributing to technical design, deployment practices, and operational excellence. You will collaborate across teams, take ownership of assigned changes, and help ensure that services remain reliable, maintainable, and compatible as the platform evolves. Implement backend services within high-performance, distributed systems, working with senior engineers on complex technical decisions. Contribute to service architecture and API development for internal teams and external integrations, ensuring appropriate communication guarantees, idempotency, and backward compatibility. Apply modern engineering practices, including test-driven and behavior-driven development where appropriate. Write clean, maintainable code supported by meaningful unit and integration tests. Integrate AI tools into the development workflow, critically reviewing and validating generated output. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a product-oriented environment. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate suggestions from colleagues. Document service behavior, design decisions, and operational considerations. Own assigned changes throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and production verification, including canary releases. Build observability into services and contribute to diagnosing and resolving production incidents. Requirements : You bring a solid foundation in backend engineering and practical experience developing reliable services with Java and distributed systems. You are comfortable working with databases, messaging technologies, deployment pipelines, and testing practices, and you can balance independent problem-solving with effective collaboration. Proficiency in Java and a good understanding of backend architecture, API design, and scalability fundamentals. Familiarity with distributed systems, including concurrency, error handling, and retry mechanisms. Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, and data modeling. Understanding of microservice architecture and synchronous and asynchronous service communication, particularly with Apache Kafka. Knowledge of message publishing, delivery guarantees, durability, and idempotency. Working knowledge of CI/CD workflows and experience using existing pipelines to deploy changes. Basic hands-on experience with canary deployments and an understanding of their operational constraints, including backward-compatible changes when multiple service versions coexist. Experience diagnosing and resolving production incidents, with an understanding of alerts, metrics, logs, and observability. Ability to instrument application code and understand how telemetry is collected, delivered, and aggregated across different sources. Practical experience writing unit and integration tests, with sound judgment about what to test and at which level. Regular experience using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to select appropriate tasks for AI and validate its output. Interest in the payments industry, particularly payment routing, retries, and subscriptions, is an advantage. Professional development: Access courses, conferences, an internal learning library, and English lessons. Healthcare and wellbeing: Medical insurance, a mental health program, and compensation for sessions with a psychologist. Paid time off: 28 paid days off annually, sick leave, and fully covered public holidays. Techni

jobs.title: Content Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Create and manage engaging digital content that supports users throughout their well-being journeys. You will contribute to the development of new content experiences, leverage AI tools to streamline production, and ensure all materials are accurately implemented and tested before release. Develop engaging in-app lessons based on content topics, advertising creatives, user requests, feedback, and identified customer pain points. Collaborate with your manager to create relevant content that improves user engagement and helps reduce subscription cancellations. Write clear, engaging, and accessible English-language content tailored to the platform's audience and objectives. Ensure all content is accurately uploaded and configured within the content management system. Test different user journeys and content flows to identify potential issues and ensure a smooth experience before new releases. Introduce and develop new in-app content formats, including quizzes, practical exercises, and interactive experiences. Coordinate the operational implementation of new content formats, ensuring all materials are properly created and integrated into the content system with support from the team. Produce videos for the application in accordance with the established content calendar and creative guidelines. Leverage existing AI tools and workflows, including Claude, to support video creation and improve content production efficiency. Continuously explore opportunities to improve content quality, variety, and effectiveness through experimentation with AI-powered solutions. Requirements : The ideal candidate combines strong English writing abilities with practical experience in digital content creation, AI-powered tools, or content management systems. You should be comfortable experimenting with new technologies, working independently, and managing content production tasks with accuracy and attention to detail. English proficiency at B2 level or higher, with the ability to create clear, engaging written content in English from day one. Previous experience writing English-language content. A portfolio is welcome but not mandatory. Regular hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable platforms to create content. Ability to provide 2–3 examples of AI-assisted work, explaining the prompts used, the content produced, and the final results. Alternatively, experience developing personalized AI workflows, including prompt templates, projects, or custom assistants for text or video production. Experience working with a content management system (CMS), administrative panel, or similar platform for uploading and managing digital content. Alternatively, practical experience creating or editing videos using traditional software or AI-powered tools. Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills. Attention to detail and the ability to review content, identify errors, and ensure accuracy before publication. Creativity and curiosity, with an interest in experimenting with new content formats and technologies. Ability to collaborate effectively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous experience working in a digital product company. Experience creating different types of content from scratch, including videos, assessments, quizzes, and practical exercises. Previous experience in the wellness or mental health industry. Academic or professional background in psychology or a related discipline. Genuine interest in mental health, personal development, and improving people's well-being. Benefits : Fully remote working opportunity. Opportunity to contribute to digital well-being products with a global audience. Hands-on experience using advanced AI tools for content and video production. Exposure to innovative content formats and AI-powered product experiences. Opportunity to take ownership of creative projects and contribute new ideas. Collaborative environment

jobs.title: Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Own and lead end-to-end compliance programs and audit processes covering SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 42001, GDPR, and HIPAA/HITECH. Plan and coordinate audits, manage evidence collection, maintain documentation, and ensure audit readiness and timely delivery of required materials. Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, customers, and prospective clients on information security and compliance matters. Lead enterprise customer security discussions, including in-depth security reviews, assessments, and questionnaire responses. Oversee internal and external security assessments across systems, services, and organizational teams. Manage and continuously improve the Third-Party Risk Management program, including the assessment and ongoing monitoring of vendors and business partners. Maintain, enhance, and scale security controls, governance practices, and compliance processes throughout the organization. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate regulatory and security requirements into practical technical and operational implementations. Track remediation activities, coordinate responsible stakeholders, and ensure identified gaps are resolved within agreed timelines. Prepare and present audit findings, compliance updates, and risk reports to internal stakeholders and senior leadership. Promote security awareness across teams and provide strategic guidance on emerging regulatory requirements, industry standards, and compliance trends. Requirements: 6+ years of experience in Information Security, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), auditing, or risk management. Strong practical knowledge of security and compliance frameworks, particularly SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, and HIPAA/HITECH. Demonstrated experience independently owning and leading audits and compliance initiatives from planning through completion. Experience working with cloud-based environments and distributed systems; AWS experience is preferred. Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives. Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, supported by a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Ability to translate complex security, risk, and compliance requirements into clear documentation and accessible business language. Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including experience engaging technical teams, external auditors, enterprise customers, and other stakeholders. High degree of curiosity, adaptability, initiative, and ownership when addressing evolving security challenges. Excellent written and spoken English. Relevant professional certifications are strongly preferred, including one or more of the following: CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor, or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor. Experience implementing ISO/IEC 27001 is an additional advantage. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within Europe. Full-time employment. Opportunity to take ownership of strategic security and compliance programs. High-impact role contributing directly to customer trust, enterprise security, and organizational growth. Collaboration with international teams across engineering, product, security, and leadership. Professional development through exposure to evolving security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and emerging compliance practices. Equal-opportunity and inclusive recruitment environment.

jobs.title: SDR Manager International
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead and manage the international SDR team, initially comprising four representatives and expected to grow to seven by the end of Q1 2027. Own team pipeline performance, focusing on increasing the volume of high-value opportunities worth $100K or more and improving conversion across the sales funnel. Coach SDRs through regular call reviews, email reviews, and deal debriefs, providing actionable feedback to strengthen performance. Establish clear expectations and ensure accountability for activity levels, conversion rates, quota attainment, and pipeline quality. Monitor performance metrics, identify gaps, and connect SDR activities to pipeline generation and revenue outcomes. Develop and scale effective inbound and outbound sales development processes that align with Account Executive requirements. Recruit, onboard, train, and ramp new SDRs while supporting their ongoing professional development and career progression. Collaborate with Marketing, Account Executives, Revenue Operations, and Sales Leadership to improve lead generation, qualification, and sales execution. Shape and optimize sales development strategies across multiple European markets and cultural environments. Requirements: 5+ years of professional sales experience, including at least 3 years managing Sales Development Representative teams. Previous success in a quota-carrying SDR and/or Account Executive role. Demonstrated experience managing sales representatives across multiple markets and cultural contexts. Proven ability to recruit, onboard, train, and develop SDRs through structured and repeatable processes. Strong analytical and metrics-driven approach to performance management, pipeline tracking, and continuous improvement. Ability to translate sales activity data into actionable insights that improve conversion and revenue contribution. Strong coaching and leadership skills, with the ability to deliver direct feedback in an empathetic, fair, and constructive manner. Fluency in English and at least one additional language: German (preferred), French, or Spanish. Familiarity with sales development and revenue tools such as Amplemarket, Orum, Gong, and HubSpot. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across international and cross-functional teams. Benefits: Competitive European base salary of €60,000–€80,000, plus €26,000–€34,000 commission. On-target earnings (OTE) of €86,000–€114,000. Equity participation. Fully remote working arrangement, with availability during EMEA time zones. Unlimited paid time off. 12–16 weeks of paid parental leave. Opportunity to build and lead a growing international sales development team. High-impact role with direct influence on pipeline generation and broader revenue objectives. Remote-first, documentation-focused working culture designed to reduce unnecessary meetings and support work-life balance.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of open-source software and commercial engineering systems. You will take ownership of meaningful technical challenges while collaborating with globally distributed teams, engaging with users, and developing a deep understanding of Linux and modern software engineering practices. Contribute to product development and help shape engineering roadmaps during global in-person team sprints held twice a year. Design and develop intuitive user experiences, including developer tools, command-line applications, and software interfaces. Write high-quality, reliable, secure, and performant code for products and services potentially used by millions of people worldwide. Develop technical expertise and progressively master key programming languages, software engineering practices, and Linux system technologies. Engage with open-source communities and users through code reviews, issue trackers, and collaborative development activities. Respond to customer issues and technical challenges, prioritizing effective solutions and developing an understanding of enterprise requirements. Apply security-conscious engineering principles throughout software design, development, and implementation. Collaborate with colleagues across different regions and technical disciplines through remote teamwork, pair programming, mentoring, and shared problem-solving. Participate in engineering discussions and contribute ideas that improve product quality, performance, usability, and long-term maintainability. Explore different engineering domains and technologies, potentially including kernels, drivers, cloud computing, containers, Kubernetes, embedded Linux, AI/ML, data science, and distributed systems. Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within engineering teams and the wider open-source ecosystem. Requirements : The ideal candidate is an academically high-performing graduate with strong programming fundamentals, a genuine passion for open-source technologies, and the motivation to tackle complex engineering challenges. You should demonstrate curiosity, initiative, accountability, and the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an international engineering team. Bachelor's degree completed or expected in 2026 or 2027 in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, or another STEM discipline that includes programming coursework. Exceptional academic performance throughout high school and university, supported by strong results or recognized academic achievements. Confidence in developing and delivering high-quality software using at least one of the following languages: Python, Rust, C, C++, Go, JavaScript, or Java. Practical experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution. Personal technology or software engineering projects completed outside academic coursework or professional employment. Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and enthusiasm for learning complex software systems. Excellent written and spoken English. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across international and distributed teams. A results-oriented and organized approach, with the motivation to meet commitments and deliver high-quality outcomes. Curiosity, flexibility, personal accountability, and a willingness to take ownership of responsibilities. Self-awareness, thoughtful decision-making, and the ability to reflect on feedback and continuously improve. Willingness and ability to travel internationally two to four times per year for company events lasting approximately one to two weeks. Nice-to-have qualifications: Previous contributions to upstream open-source projects. Experience with software packaging or Linux distributions such as Debian, Fedora, Arch, or Nix. Leadership, organizational, or team coordination experience. Strong presentation, technical writing, and documentation skills. Interes

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Build, maintain, and improve backend services and APIs that support the platform. Design, query, and optimise databases to ensure performance, reliability, and effective data management. Collaborate with backend engineers to develop and deliver new product features. Participate in code reviews, providing constructive, direct, and respectful feedback. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues affecting production systems. Contribute to system reliability and help maintain the quality and stability of backend services. Write and update technical documentation to support collaboration across distributed teams. Develop expertise in a chosen product area and take end-to-end ownership of at least one feature or service. Requirements: Solid working knowledge of at least one backend programming language, such as Python or Elixir. Experience developing and working with APIs, including REST or similar technologies. Good understanding of databases, data manipulation, and SQL, ideally with PostgreSQL. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Ability to work effectively with distributed teams across different time zones, using clear written communication and shared documentation. Strong sense of ownership, with a commitment to building and maintaining reliable services. Collaborative approach to engineering, including active participation in technical discussions and code reviews. Ability to deliver an initial version early, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve solutions. Nice to have: Experience with Elixir and the Phoenix framework. Familiarity with cloud services, particularly AWS. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement for candidates based in Europe or Africa (GMT+1). Paid time off (PTO), including one additional PTO day for each year of service. National public holidays applicable in the employee's country. Maternity and paternity leave. Equipment allowance. Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). Opportunity to work with an international team across multiple countries and time zones. Professional growth through feature ownership and the opportunity to develop deep product expertise.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Role & Responsibilities: Take responsibility for the scalability, stability and availability of our low-latency and mission-critical systems. Enhance the CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions. Generate and maintain Helm manifests for Kubernetes. Maintain our Infrastructure as Code. Set up and maintain monitoring via New Relic, Prometheus and Grafana. Debug infrastructure and detect bottlenecks. Take responsibility for the company-wide tech infrastructure across all environments. Manage VPN, load balancers and firewalls. Take responsibility for high availability and disaster recovery. Implement secure and stable infrastructure. Drive continuous improvement and cost optimization. Take responsibility for 24x7 monitoring, resolving infrastructure-tier incidents and escalating to upper tiers where necessary. Investigate incidents and produce clear incident report documentation. Skills: Excellent understanding of GCP cloud and AWS cloud. Knowledge of containerized environments with Kubernetes and Docker. Ability to develop a well-managed infrastructure setup. Strong hands-on experience building high availability infrastructure using EKS on AWS. Strong understanding of IaC, specifically Terraform. Strong understanding of GitOps , specifically ArgoCD. Strong understanding of securing production infrastructure. Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in DevOps on production applications. Minimum 1 year working with Terraform. Minimum 1 year working with infrastructure monitoring tools. Experience in designing and architecting high performing applications. Experience in agile development practices. Experience in a fast growing startup is a plus. AWS certifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Product - AdTech
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead the overall product strategy and development of the AdTech portfolio, identifying opportunities to strengthen mobile advertising capabilities and deliver measurable value to game developers. You will combine strategic leadership, market research, technical expertise, and hands-on product execution to build solutions that support sustainable customer and business growth. Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the AdTech business. Identify emerging opportunities in mobile advertising by analyzing customer needs, market trends, competitive developments, technological advancements, and unmet industry demands. Explore how artificial intelligence and automation can transform mobile monetization and user acquisition, making sophisticated advertising solutions accessible to developers of all sizes. Develop an integrated growth ecosystem connecting ad monetization, user acquisition, and data to help game studios make informed decisions and improve profitability. Lead product initiatives from initial concept and validation through development, launch, optimization, and scaling. Establish clear product priorities, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, commercial opportunities, and long-term business objectives. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align product investments with strategic business goals. Translate complex advertising technologies into intuitive, scalable products that solve meaningful customer problems. Use data, experimentation, and performance insights to evaluate product success and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Take ownership of measurable customer outcomes, product performance, revenue contribution, and overall business growth. Encourage innovation and experimentation while supporting teams in developing stronger product thinking and execution capabilities. Requirements : We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial product leader with a strong background in AdTech, mobile advertising, or performance marketing technology. The ideal candidate combines a comprehensive understanding of the advertising ecosystem with technical curiosity, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to turn complex ideas into successful products. You should be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels, influencing senior stakeholders, and helping teams deliver ambitious product initiatives. At least 5 years of experience building, developing, and scaling products in AdTech, mobile advertising, or adjacent performance marketing technology. Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, including ad monetization, mediation, user acquisition, demand-side platforms (DSPs), supply-side platforms (SSPs), bidding mechanisms, attribution, and advertising economics. Proven track record of taking complex technical products from concept to launch and delivering measurable commercial results. Experience working with data-intensive platforms, optimization systems, machine learning, or AI-powered products. Strong understanding of customer businesses and the ability to identify problems that create meaningful, measurable value when solved. Excellent commercial judgment, with the ability to connect product decisions to customer outcomes, revenue generation, and business growth. Entrepreneurial mindset and a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, challenge conventional approaches, and build products from zero to one. Strong strategic vision combined with practical execution skills and sound technical judgment. Customer-focused approach, with the ability to translate market insights and customer needs into effective product strategies. Experience bringing cross-functional teams together, coaching product professionals, and raising standards for product development. Performance-driven attitude, with a willingness to experiment, learn from setbacks, and continuously improve. Excellent communication

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own the planning and execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to generate qualified leads, accelerate pipeline development, and support revenue growth. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful campaigns, optimize marketing resources, and demonstrate the commercial value of marketing investments. Design and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns across email, social media, targeted advertising lists, and other digital channels to attract qualified prospects and generate measurable pipeline. Develop and implement campaign strategies promoting cloud productivity and AI solutions, ensuring alignment with broader go-to-market objectives. Collaborate with internal creative, copywriting, and content teams to develop and deploy compelling marketing assets that communicate product value and support campaign performance. Leverage existing content and marketing resources, adapting and localizing materials to meet campaign requirements and create effective sales enablement collateral. Partner with go-to-market teams to plan and execute promotional strategies for joint events and webinars, maximizing attendance and engagement among high-value prospects. Work with sales teams, customers, and internal content specialists to identify successful customer stories and develop compelling case studies that demonstrate the value of integrated technology solutions. Manage marketing development funds (MDF) compliance by preparing proof-of-performance reports, documenting campaign activities, and maintaining supporting materials required for funding validation. Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and return on investment to assess effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities. Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of marketing assets, campaign materials, and related activities. Continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign execution, strengthen collaboration, and increase marketing impact. Requirements : We are looking for a results-oriented marketing professional with a strong background in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, and integrated campaign management. The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, content marketing expertise, and excellent project management skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and translate marketing initiatives into measurable commercial results. At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B digital marketing, demand generation, or campaign management. Demonstrated ability to use content marketing and digital assets to improve lead conversion and contribute to pipeline growth. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies and demand generation best practices. Data-driven mindset, with a strong focus on tracking campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI. Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, asset creation processes, content deliveries, and marketing lists simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with sales, creative, content, and go-to-market teams. Ability to develop compelling marketing messages and leverage customer success stories to communicate business value. Experience managing marketing budgets, campaign documentation, and performance reporting is an advantage. Previous experience within a cloud technology partner ecosystem, particularly Google Cloud, Microsoft, or AWS, is preferred. Familiarity with marketing and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Google Workspace, Cvent, and Asana is considered a plus. Proactive, adaptable, and commercially minded approach, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Benefits : Annual compensation ranging from $90,000 to $110,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional

jobs.title: GTM Marketing Manager, Google Cloud
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead go-to-market coordination and partner marketing initiatives, ensuring strong alignment between external technology partners and internal commercial teams. You will translate strategic campaigns into actionable sales activities, facilitate collaboration, and deliver targeted programs that accelerate opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. Serve as the primary liaison between the Google corporate sales organization and internal commercial teams, ensuring alignment on joint pipeline objectives and go-to-market priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships across partner and internal sales organizations, facilitating communication and collaboration between different teams and sales structures. Integrate Google Workspace and Gemini messaging into broader go-to-market strategies, helping sales teams develop cohesive solution propositions and communicate combined value to customers. Translate high-level corporate marketing campaigns into targeted, account-specific sales initiatives that support commercial priorities and pipeline development. Coordinate and execute customer-facing activities, including prospective customer meetings, executive roundtables, targeted field events, and high-touch webinars designed to accelerate mid-funnel opportunities. Act as a central point of contact for sales enablement and partner communication, ensuring sellers understand how and when to access partner resources, subject matter experts, and tailored marketing collateral. Facilitate collaboration between sales teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure consistent messaging, effective campaign execution, and strong commercial alignment. Track the performance of field activations, joint marketing initiatives, and sales programs, measuring their contribution to pipeline development and business outcomes. Prepare detailed proof-of-performance reports and activity documentation for partner organizations to demonstrate marketing impact and ensure accountability for marketing development funds (MDF). Identify opportunities to improve partner collaboration, strengthen sales engagement, and increase the effectiveness of go-to-market programs. Requirements : We are looking for a relationship-oriented marketing professional with significant experience in partner, field, or channel marketing, preferably within the B2B technology sector. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial awareness with excellent stakeholder management and execution skills, enabling them to connect different sales organizations and turn strategic marketing objectives into measurable sales activities. At least 5 years of experience in partner marketing, field marketing, or channel marketing. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations and bridge different sales cultures. Proven experience translating corporate marketing strategies and high-level campaigns into practical, account-specific sales initiatives. Experience planning, organizing, and executing targeted customer meetings, field events, executive engagements, and sales activation programs. Strong understanding of B2B marketing strategies and the relationship between partner marketing, sales enablement, and pipeline development. Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and facilitate collaboration between external partners and internal commercial teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and maintain productive professional relationships. Strong organizational and project management abilities, including the coordination of events, campaigns, and marketing resources. Analytical mindset and experience tracking marketing program performance, preparing activity reports, and demonstrating return on investment. Previous experience working closely with enterprise B2B technology sales teams or within major cloud partner ecosystems is preferred. Familiarity

jobs.title: Support Systems & Programs Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: The Support Systems & Programs Lead will oversee the people, technology, and processes that support efficient and scalable customer service operations. The role requires strategic ownership of the Support tooling ecosystem, hands-on technical guidance, and strong cross-functional collaboration to improve service quality and operational performance. Lead, coach, and develop Systems and Programs engineers, supporting their technical growth and career progression. Establish clear team responsibilities, planning processes, and delivery rhythms to ensure consistent execution against priorities. Contribute to hiring and onboarding while remaining involved in technical decisions and hands-on problem-solving. Own the Support tooling portfolio and define a prioritised roadmap that enables Reactive and Proactive Support to scale. Establish structured project intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to focus engineering resources on high-impact initiatives. Collaborate with Support leadership and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Legal, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships. Lead the expansion of AI-powered Support solutions across different support tiers to increase the proportion of tickets resolved through AI. Guide the development, maintenance, and adoption of reliable automations, AI agents, and integrations that reduce repetitive tasks and improve efficiency. Track the impact of AI and automation through metrics such as time saved, AI-handled ticket share, and cost per AI-handled ticket. Rebuild and optimise foundational Support processes to ensure workflows are efficient, documented, and scalable. Establish governance for standard operating procedures (SOPs), tooling ownership, and automation reliability. Monitor tooling adoption, SOP compliance, operational efficiency, and the capacity freed up for Support teams. Drive continuous improvement across Support systems, processes, and operational foundations. Requirements : The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in workflow automation and SaaS systems, combined with proven engineering leadership experience. They should be comfortable translating operational challenges into technical roadmaps, implementing AI-powered solutions, and aligning stakeholders around shared priorities. Practical experience building complex workflows with n8n is essential. Hands-on experience building and maintaining complex workflows and automations using n8n. Strong technical foundations, including APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, and SaaS architecture. Proven experience owning and improving technical Support systems, tooling, and automations in a B2B SaaS environment. At least 5 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers, supporting their development, and ensuring high-quality delivery. Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into clear technical priorities and manage a technical roadmap. Experience implementing AI agents or AI-assisted Support tools to improve operational efficiency. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams. Experience as a developer, in DevOps, or working on an automation-focused technical product is an advantage. Familiarity with Support performance metrics and analytics or dashboarding tools such as Hex or Metabase is a plus. Experience in open-source or community-led SaaS environments is beneficial. Previous experience working in distributed, remote-first teams, ideally within a European startup or scale-up, is desirable. Strong coaching, communication, prioritisation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical involvement and operational ownership. Professional proficiency in English, the organisation's working language. Must have existing legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom, as visa sponsorship is available for Germany only. Benefits : Competitive compensation. Equity participa

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Identification & JS Agent
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Technical Product Manager, you will coordinate the delivery of assigned product features and initiatives while ensuring that requirements, documentation, dependencies, and stakeholder communications remain clear and up to date. You will work alongside senior product leadership and technical teams to support execution, gather insights, prepare launches, and monitor product performance. Product Delivery & Execution Own delivery coordination for assigned product features, epics, and workstreams within the priorities and constraints established by the Senior Technical Product Manager. Translate product direction into actionable user stories, jobs-to-be-done (JTBD), acceptance criteria, and definitions of done. Maintain Jira epics, tasks, acceptance criteria, and delivery updates in collaboration with Engineering. Keep product systems and records accurate and current, including Notion, Jira, Productboard, and relevant roadmap and release tracking tools. Support backlog refinement, sprint planning readiness, delivery sequencing, and release preparation. Track delivery risks, dependencies, unresolved questions, and key decisions, escalating issues when they affect business objectives, customer commitments, timelines, scope, pricing, eligibility, or strategic priorities. Participate in technical reviews and develop sufficient technical understanding to contribute to discussions about architecture, implementation, and trade-offs. Product Documentation & Communication Create and maintain clear feature documentation under the guidance of senior product leadership. Document product use cases and confidently explain assigned features to internal stakeholders. Support Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) by preparing user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and relevant customer and business context. Draft or contribute to internal release notes, product updates, and stakeholder communications. Ensure developer documentation is updated whenever product behavior or functionality changes. Communicate feature progress, known limitations, delivery timelines, and release readiness to relevant internal teams. Customer, Market & Product Insights Monitor customer feedback, support channels, Productboard insights, and requests from internal stakeholders. Identify recurring issues and potential product limitations or improvement opportunities. Participate in customer discovery activities, brainstorming sessions, user experience discussions, and product feedback reviews. Gather qualitative and quantitative insights to support product prioritization and decision-making. Monitor the competitive landscape and stay informed about relevant technical developments and market trends within assigned product areas. Product Operations & Launch Support Maintain roadmap and feature records as initiatives progress through their lifecycle. Coordinate launch readiness across Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support. jobs.title: Contract Recruiter
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: The Contract Recruiter will manage end-to-end recruitment activities for clinical educator network projects, ensuring candidates are identified, assessed, and progressed efficiently while supporting evolving business and geographic staffing needs. Post open positions across relevant recruitment channels and sourcing platforms. Identify, source, screen, and interview candidates in line with project requirements. Coordinate second-level interviews with relevant stakeholders when required. Initiate the contracting process for the most qualified candidates. Manage candidate records and recruitment progress within the applicant tracking system (ATS). Track applicants throughout the recruitment lifecycle and maintain accurate internal recruitment reports and tracking documents. Collaborate with business teams to identify geographic coverage gaps and additional talent requirements. Proactively develop solutions to address talent shortages and recruitment challenges. They are comfortable managing high-volume recruitment with tight turnaround times and can combine strong sourcing expertise with excellent organization, communication, and stakeholder management skills. At least 3 years of sourcing and recruiting experience; experience in pharma, biotech, and/or clinician recruitment is preferred. Expert-level proficiency with candidate sourcing platforms. Current hands-on experience using a robust applicant tracking system. Demonstrated success managing high-volume recruitment and delivering results within short timelines. Understanding of healthcare-related business activities and service offerings. Strong project management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A collaborative, solution-oriented approach and a strong customer service mindset. Ability to adapt quickly, manage competing priorities, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and reporting capabilities. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office. Bachelor’s degree preferred. Benefits : Contract-based, remote work arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to recruitment initiatives supporting healthcare and patient engagement programs. Collaboration with recruitment and business teams in a specialized life sciences environment.

jobs.title: Creative & Community Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take ownership of the brand's overall narrative, ensuring that its communication remains consistent, authentic, and relevant across all audience touchpoints. You will combine community insights, strategic planning, creative development, and direct execution to build meaningful engagement and strengthen brand perception. Monitor customer sentiment and public perception through community discussions, CS2 conversations, customer support feedback, Product insights, and business intelligence. Identify what audiences appreciate, what concerns them, and how their perceptions evolve over time. Collaborate with management and Product teams to translate business direction and product developments into a clear, compelling brand narrative. Ensure consistency across social media, blogs, product communications, community interactions, and larger content initiatives while adapting messaging to different audiences. Develop and manage content plans aligned with product roadmaps, events, releases, and developments within the CS2 and esports communities. Create engaging content concepts, including gaming-related productions, community-focused initiatives, collaborations, short-form videos, and larger creative projects. Maximize the value of content production by repurposing collaborations, shoots, and creative assets into multiple deliverables. Direct designers, editors, copywriters, creators, and external production partners, providing clear briefs, feedback, and creative guidance. Take responsibility for the quality and final delivery of creative projects while remaining actively involved in execution. Maintain an authentic and continuous presence within the community, ensuring communication feels natural, relevant, and genuinely engaged rather than limited to promotional announcements. Manage creative resources and production budgets thoughtfully, balancing quality, impact, and commercial efficiency. Requirements : We are looking for a proactive, independent, and highly creative professional with strong storytelling abilities and the confidence to take ownership of both strategy and execution. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills, emotional intelligence, audience awareness, and commercial judgment with the ability to lead creative projects and collaborate effectively across different teams. Demonstrated ability to take initiative, work independently, and deliver results without requiring constant direction or extensive team support. Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and translate ideas into engaging content. Hands-on approach, with the ability to contribute directly to content creation and execution rather than relying entirely on others. High emotional intelligence and a strong understanding of psychology, audience behavior, and brand perception. Curiosity and research skills, with a genuine interest in understanding what communities are discussing, appreciating, and criticizing. Strong organizational and project management abilities, including content planning, prioritization, and execution. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with management, Product, Customer Relations, BI, and creative professionals. Experience directing creative work, briefing collaborators, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining high-quality output. Commercial awareness and the ability to manage production, collaboration, and external contractor costs efficiently. Familiarity with CS2, esports, gaming, and internet culture is highly desirable, along with the ability to become deeply immersed in these communities quickly. Benefits : Opportunity to take ownership of the brand's creative direction, storytelling, and community presence. A hands-on, high-impact role combining strategic responsibility with creative execution. Direct collaboration with management, Product teams, and creative professionals. Opp

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Treasury Analyst, you will manage and support essential treasury activities, ensuring financial accuracy, effective liquidity management, and compliance across domestic and international operations. You will collaborate with treasury and accounting teams, maintain banking relationships, and deliver financial analysis that supports operational efficiency and informed decision-making. Prepare daily cash positioning reports within the Treasury Management System (TMS) to support global liquidity management. Monitor and reconcile cash-related accounts, including bank accounts, cash held in kiosks, and cash in transit. Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure transactions are accurately recorded and consistent with accounting records. Investigate and resolve discrepancies and variances across financial accounts. Prepare reconciliation reports and provide supporting documentation to the accounting team during monthly closing processes. Manage banking relationships and administer domestic and international bank accounts. Liaise with financial institutions to obtain bank statements, transaction reports, and updates on cash positions. Monitor fund disbursements and ensure income and expenditure are recorded in accordance with internal procedures and applicable international accounting standards. Maintain accurate and comprehensive treasury records for all financial transactions. Develop and maintain daily, 13-week, and 26-week cash forecasts to ensure sufficient liquidity for operational requirements. Prepare financial models, management reports, and ad hoc analyses covering budget utilization, cash positions, and financial variances. Investigate deviations from financial forecasts, explain discrepancies, and propose preliminary recommendations for management review. Monitor financial activities for unusual transactions or potential compliance concerns, supporting investigations and appropriate reporting. Review budget proposals submitted by other departments and identify technical errors or inconsistencies. Provide detailed financial analysis and explanations regarding account balances and overall treasury performance. Support treasury leadership in financial planning, liquidity decisions, and broader business strategy. Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve forecasting, reporting, and daily financial workflows. Requirements: The ideal candidate has a strong background in treasury management, accounting, or corporate finance, with hands-on experience managing cash flows, reconciliations, and financial forecasting. You should combine advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities with practical knowledge of ERP and treasury management systems. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently are essential. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. MBA preferred. At least 3 years of professional experience in treasury analysis, treasury management, or a similar financial role. CPA or Certified Management Accountant (CMA) certification is an advantage. Proven experience developing and maintaining financial models and cash flow forecasts. Hands-on experience with NetSuite, particularly ERP, general ledger, and financial reporting functions. Experience with FIS Workstation, Kyriba, ION Treasury, or comparable Treasury Management Systems (TMS) for cash positioning, bank connectivity, and liquidity management. Familiarity with Microsoft Access or other database management applications. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including: VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and INDEX-MATCH formulas.
