Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. jobs.title: Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready. Supplier Quality & Compliance Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements. Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain. Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data. Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable. Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations. Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships. Ingredient Quality Management Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders. Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications. Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations. Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition. Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks. Quality Systems & Document Control Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions. Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention. Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready. Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements. Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency. Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks. Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers. Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities. Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions. Provide leadership with visibility into supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and outstanding corrective actions. Requirements : The ideal candidate has 6–8+ years of Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality experience in the food and beverage industry, preferably within beverage manufacturing. You bring strong technical knowledge of food safety systems and supplier compliance, combined with the ability to manage investigations, audits, and corrective action programs. You are analytical, organized, and comfortable influencing external suppliers and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities. 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality within the food and beverage industry; beverage experience is preferred. 0–2 years of experience

jobs.title: FP&A AI Research Contributor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Leverage your FP&A expertise to develop realistic, practical tasks that replicate the responsibilities and challenges of financial planning and analysis professionals. Work through each assignment to establish accurate expected outcomes and create objective evaluation criteria that can be used to assess AI-generated results. Develop realistic FP&A tasks based on your professional experience and everyday financial workflows. Create domain-specific assignments and deliverables using Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and other relevant professional tools. Complete each task independently to establish a clear, accurate, and reliable reference answer. Identify common mistakes and limitations in AI-generated financial analysis and incorporate relevant scenarios into evaluation tasks. Develop precise yes-or-no evaluation criteria that allow graders to consistently assess the accuracy and quality of AI-generated outputs. Follow provided project guidelines and collaborate with the research team to ensure tasks meet quality expectations. Apply attention to detail and professional judgment throughout the task creation and evaluation process. Requirements: The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in financial planning and analysis, with a strong understanding of financial workflows and the ability to translate professional knowledge into structured, practical assignments. You should be comfortable producing and reviewing financial deliverables, communicating clearly in English, and exploring how AI tools can support or improve finance-related activities. Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A). Relevant professional qualifications are valued, including ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CA, or ACA. Strong written English communication skills and the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly. Practical experience using financial tools and producing professional deliverables in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and gaps in financial outputs. Willingness to learn about artificial intelligence, AI evaluation methodologies, and emerging concepts in AI assessments. Ability to develop structured tasks and objective evaluation criteria. Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and deliver high-quality assignments within the required timelines. Benefits: Fully remote independent contractor opportunity. Flexible working schedule, allowing you to complete tasks on your own schedule. Immediate start available. Initial project duration of approximately 4–6 weeks. Task-based compensation, with payment issued weekly following task completion. Opportunity to qualify for additional assignments throughout the project after successfully completing the first task within the required timeline. Potential for project extensions depending on business needs and individual performance. Opportunity to apply your FP&A expertise to real-world AI training and evaluation initiatives. Exposure to emerging AI technologies and professional AI assessment methodologies. No requirement to access confidential or proprietary information belonging to current or previous employers, clients, or institutions.

Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com Job Overview Want to help bring a world-class digital product to audiences around the globe? As a Production Coordinator on our client’s Localization team, you’ll support the localization of product features, marketing campaigns, editorial content, and web experiences across multiple markets. You’ll work alongside Senior Coordinators and Project Managers to deliver high-quality work on time, while building your expertise in localization operations and cross-functional collaboration. This role is built to grow. The localization function is shifting toward AI-first workflows, and over the next 12 months you’ll move from supported operational work toward independently running AI-assisted localization workflows. You’ll run traditional processes while building the skills to be the human judgment layer for AI output, and you’ll take on greater cross-functional ownership along the way. We’re hiring for today’s work and for where this role is heading. The mindset matters more than prior experience Skills & Experience Curiosity and self-drive: when you meet a new tool or process, you dig in rather than wait to be shown The ability to build strong working relationships through empathy, respect, and reliability Experience in project coordination, localization operations, or a similar role is helpful, but not required if you bring the right mindset A willingness to keep growing as your role expands Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent prac

jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. As an Outbound Sales Development Representative focusing on the Maritime sector, you will be the driving force behind expanding Kpler’s footprint across the EMEA region. You will spearhead outbound prospecting efforts, identifying and connecting with key industry leaders to introduce our industry-leading platforms, including MarineTraffic and Kpler. In this role, you will bridge the gap between market intelligence and customer success by creating meaningful sales pipeline that accelerates regional revenue growth. Key Responsibilities: Drive Strategic Prospecting: Map out key decision-makers and organizational hierarchies across target New Logo maritime accounts within the EMEA region. Execute Multi-Channel Outreach: Craft and deploy tailored outbound campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp to articulate Kpler’s value proposition to executive stakeholders. Qualify High-Impact Opportunities: Apply the BANT framework to thoroughly evaluate prospective client requirements and determine high-fit opportunities. Generate Pipeline & Book Meetings: Secure qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives to consistently build and accelerate the sales pipeline. Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Business Development leadership to synchronize campaign strategies and optimize outreach around product releases. Maintain CRM Excellence: Systematically capture market intelligence, customer interactions, and pipeline data within Salesforce to ensure pipeline visibility and operational efficiency. Deepen Industry Expertise: Develop a thorough understanding of maritime workflows and user personas to position Kpler's data solutions credibly in every interaction. Experience & Background: What you’ll need (Must-haves): 2+ years of outbound business development or sales development experience in a B2B SaaS/technology environment. Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding outbound prospecting activity metrics and meeting quotas. Demonstrated expertise conducting multi-channel outbound campaigns using modern sales engagement platforms and phone outreach. Exceptional professional communication and active listening skills in English, with the ability to engage senior decision-makers credibly. A structured, hunter-oriented approach with strong discipline in pipeline tracking and CRM hygiene (preferably Salesforce). Nice-to-haves: Domain knowledge or direct experience prospecting into the Maritime, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Energy & Commodities sectors. Hands-on experience applying structured qualification methodologies such as BANT or equivalent qualification frameworks. Practical familiarity with sales engagement tools including LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach. Professional working proficiency in additional European languages. A Bachelor’s degree in business, international relations, logistics, or a related field.

jobs.title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Vehicle Inspection Specialist Employment Type: Full-time, On-site Location: Soum Car Showroom, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Operations Language Requirement: Fluent in Arabic Role Overview Every car Soum hands over carries our name, so its condition has to be exactly what we promised. The Vehicle Inspection Specialist owns the technical truth about each vehicle: you inspect it when it first comes in, identify and document any damage or defects, carry out the final inspection before handover, and assess technical issues raised after the sale. You also support the Cars Operations team with day-to-day operational tasks. This is a technical role, not a customer-facing one. The After-Sales Customer Experience Specialist owns all customer communication, complaints, and follow-ups. You give them accurate, clearly documented findings so they can keep the customer informed and resolve the case. The goal of the role: no car leaves the showroom with an undocumented defect, every inspection report is accurate and complete, and technical issues are diagnosed quickly and routed to the right fix. Duties & Responsibilities: Vehicle Handover Schedule handover appointments with customers and confirm the time, location, and documents they need to bring. Before each appointment, confirm that the car has passed its pre-handover check and that all accessories are present: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Walk the customer through the car's condition and inspection report, and introduce its key features. Sign the handover form with the customer and document it with photos. Vehicle Inspection & Condition Assessment Conduct the initial inspection of every vehicle, covering the body, exterior, interior, and overall condition, against Soum's approved inspection checklist. Assess mechanical and electrical components, including the engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and report any damage, defects, previous repairs, issues, or discrepancies against what was listed or agreed with the buyer. Assess the overall condition of each vehicle and record it consistently, so that condition ratings mean the same thing across every car. Inspection Reports & Documentation Produce a clear, accurate inspection report for every vehicle inspected, written so that a non-technical colleague can explain it to a customer. Take photographs of each vehicle's condition and of every defect found, and attach them to the report. Record all findings, reports, and photos in the system so they are available to Sales and After-Sales. Keep inspection records complete and up to date, so the condition of any vehicle at any stage can be verified. Pre-Handover Checks Conduct the final inspection before vehicle handover or completion, confirming the car matches its inspection report and has not changed in condition since it was listed. Verify that every car is complete with all accessories: keys, manual, and spare tyre. Confirm that the car is ready, or flag what must be fixed before the handover appointment. Post-Sale Technical Issues & Escalation Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, using the case details passed on by the After-Sales CX Specialist. Determine the likely cause, whether the issue was present at handover, and the recommended fix. Document your technical findings in the case so the After-Sales CX Specialist can update the customer. Escalate technical issues outside your authority in line with approved procedures. Workshops & Cars Operations Brief approved maintenance workshops on the technical findings and the work required. Review completed repairs and confirm the issue has been fixed before the case is closed. Feed recurring defects and post-sale technical complaints back into the inspection checklist to improve future inspections. Coordinate with the Operations team throughout the car journey, from initial inspection to handover. Support other Cars Operations tasks when requir

jobs.title: Senior Crude Oil Analyst
jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Crude Oil Research Analyst based in Dubai, you will serve as Kpler’s regional market authority on Middle Eastern physical crude dynamics, focusing on refinery activity, product yields, and downstream trade flows. Operating at the crossroads of physical cargo tracking and fundamental market analysis, you will translate complex refinery runs and crude movements into clear, actionable intelligence. In this high-impact individual contributor role, your insights will directly empower global commodity traders and market participants to navigate physical trading, arbitrage, and downstream market shifts with confidence. Key Responsibilities:: Deliver in-depth market intelligence: Conduct rigorous research on Middle Eastern physical crude and refined product markets, focusing on refinery runs, crude throughput, planned maintenance, and physical trade flows . Advance supply, demand, and refinery modeling: Maintain and refine proprietary supply-demand and refinery activity models, ensuring high data integrity compared against international benchmarks such as JODI, EIA, and IEA . Strengthen OSP advisory capabilities: Spearhead analysis and client-facing insights around Middle Eastern Official Selling Prices (OSPs), pricing mechanisms, and crude grade differentials . Publish timely market commentary: Author high-quality research reports, concise market briefs, and ad-hoc commentary highlighting Kpler’s proprietary cargo and inventory data for global clients . Represent Kpler across the industry: Present regional market insights during client briefings, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements to expand Kpler’s thought leadership across the Middle East . Drive commercial and product innovation: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Engineering teams to support pre-sales discussions, demonstrate data value, and co-develop next-generation analytics offerings . Experience & Background:: 5+ years of prior professional experience analysing crude oil markets, with deep familiarity with refinery operations, trading dynamics, and physical trade flows . Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics, or Energy Management) . Proven track record of independently researching, analysing, and writing clear, data-driven market commentary and insights . Strong data analytics and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience manipulating complex datasets to assess supply, demand, and refinery margins . Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to convey technical market context to clients, media, and cross-functional teams . Nice-to-haves: Practical experience using Kpler cargo-tracking data, AIS platforms, or similar energy intelligence tools . Working familiarity with data querying and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or R . Direct familiarity with Middle Eastern crude pricing benchmarks, national oil company (NOC) pricing structures, and regional refinery configurations .

jobs.description: We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join an Arabic (Gulf) voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies. Job Type: Freelance Location: Work from home Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day) Project Duration: Approximately 1 month Start Date: Immediately Rate: 6 USD/hour Help Shape the Future of AI This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect. You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents. How Your Recordings Will Be Used Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems. Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided. Speak using your natural dialect and accent. Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered. Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards. Complete tasks using our internal recording platform. What We’re Looking For: Native-level fluency in Arabic (Gulf). Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use. Advanced level of English to understand written instructions. Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent. Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own. Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required. Strong communication skills and attention to detail. Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy. Technical Requirements: Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise. Computer microphone or headset with microphone. Reliable internet connection. Ability to access and use an online recording platform. What We Offer: Flexible, remote work. Timely and reliable payments. Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology. Access to future language and AI-related projects. A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

jobs.title: Consumer Product Manager
jobs.description: About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities: Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen. Keep a close eye on regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players, and bring the best ideas back to Soum, adapted for our customers. Requirements: 2–4 years of product management experience on consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech or consumer apps. A proven track record of shipping consumer features that moved measurable business metrics, and the ability to explain exactly how. Strong consumer intuition backed by data: comfortable with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis and A/B testing; working SQL is a strong plus. Hands-on experience building for mobile (iOS and Android) and web. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust and pricing. Experience working closely with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specs and sharp prioritisation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management, able to align operations, commercial and tech teams around a decision. A true owner who moves fast, takes decisions with incomplete information and cares more about outcomes than output.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President – Data Science
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE As an AVP– Data Science, you will design, build, and productionize advanced analytics and AI solutions that drive measurable business value. You will work closely with Data Product Owners, Data Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Quality Specialists to translate complex business challenges into data-driven models and experiments. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern ML frameworks, you will develop scalable machine learning solutions that are explainable, governed, and aligned with organizational priorities. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Translate business problems into data science projects by defining clear hypotheses, success metrics, and validation methods. Explore, clean, and transform structured and unstructured data using Python and SQL to prepare high-quality datasets for modeling. Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models using appropriate algorithms and statistical techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, NLP, forecasting). Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to productionize AI models through reproducible pipelines and CI/CD workflows. Apply model explainability, fairness, and interpretability techniques (e.g., SHAP, LIME, feature importance) to ensure transparency and accountability. Support AI governance activities, including Model Risk Management (MRM) processes, ensuring compliance and responsible use of AI. Conduct and analyze A/B tests or controlled experiments to assess model and feature performance. Work with Data Product Owners to define business outcomes, monitor model performance post-deployment, and ensure continued relevance. Collaborate with Data Quality Specialists to ensure input data meets quality, lineage, and governance standards. Communicate results effectively through visualizations, storytelling, and presentations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences. RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE 6+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or advanced analytics. Proven experience delivering models that have been deployed and integrated into business processes or digital products. Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM). Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and validation. Experience working in Databricks or equivalent data and ML platforms. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of model explainability, ethics, fairness, and governance. Knowledge of AI governance processes and documentation standards, including Model Risk Management (MRM). Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, Snowflake) and APIs for integrating AI models into applications. Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and collaborative coding practices. Excellent communication skills to explain technical findings in clear business terms. Collaborative and curious, with a passion for continuous learning and innovation QUALIFICATION Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master’s degree or higher in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Statistics is an advantage.

jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE Own the data backbone of the Group: the platforms through which data is ingested, stored, modeled, governed and made available for analytics, Artificial Intelligence and operational use across Aldar and its subsidiaries. Establish end-to-end accountability from data platform engineering to operations, building AI-ready foundations and a self-service model that lets Group Digital and the business consume trusted data at speed, without the data platform becoming a bottleneck. Serve Group Digital's Data & AI teams with data and self-service capabilities; analytics and data science ownership remains with Group Digital. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Data Platform Strategy & Architecture: Define and evolve the Group data platform architecture: ingestion, storage, modeling, processing and serving layers. Design for reuse, scalability, security-by-design and cost efficiency across the Group and subsidiaries. Build AI-ready foundations: pipelines, data products and platform capabilities that support advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence use cases. Data Engineering & Ingestion: Own data ingestion from enterprise and subsidiary source systems into the Group data platform, with reliable, monitored pipelines. Set engineering standards for data pipelines, data products and platform automation. Ensure database management and storage planning support performance and growth. Platform Data Governance & Quality: Implement platform-level data governance: data principles, cataloguing, lineage, quality monitoring and access controls. Safeguard master data alignment and data reliability for downstream consumers. Partner with Information Security on data protection controls across the platform. Serving Group Digital & Self-Service: Serve Group Digital's Data & AI teams with data and self-service capabilities, with clear interfaces and service commitments. Enable governed self-service for business and subsidiary teams, balancing autonomy with control. Provide centralized observability of data flows supporting digital products. Drive FinOps discipline on data platform and storage spend. Leadership & Talent Development: Build and lead the Data Platforms team, including data platform and database management capabilities. Develop data engineering depth and support Emiratization objectives. What This Role Is Not: Not an analytics or data science role; those capabilities are owned by Group Digital. Not a reporting or Business Intelligence delivery function; the role provides the platform others build on. Not limited to Aldar corporate; the platform serves the Group and its subsidiaries. This role owns the data backbone on which the Group's analytics and Artificial Intelligence ambitions are built. RELATED YEAR OF EXPERIENCE Minimum of 10-12+ years in data platform engineering or data architecture leadership within large, complex organizations. YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION Minimum of 2+ years of managerial experience in a related field. jobs.description: We’re running a short video data collection project for one of our clients. We’re looking for native Arabic speakers across multiple Arabic-speaking countries and dialects to record a 15–20 second video, speaking naturally in Arabic and looking directly into the camera. The videos collected will be used to help train and evaluate an AI model that distinguishes real, human-recorded video from AI-generated (synthetic) video. Project Details: Start Date: ASAP Duration: 1 session Commitment: 1 hour. Job Type: Freelance Location: Malaysia/Oman/Kuwait/Jordan/Türkiye/UAE/Saudi Arabia/Qatar (Remote) Language/Dialects:Yemeni Arabic Pay Rate: $4.00-$15.00 (Depending on country location) Eligibility: 18 years of age or older. Native Arabic speaker (self-identified). You may be asked to complete a brief screening step to confirm your dialect before your submission is finalized. What you’ll do : Record a single 15–20 second video in your native Arabic dialect . Speak naturally (no script). Suggested prompts: briefly introduce yourself, mention where you live, or talk about an interest/hobby. Look directly at the camera the whole time. After recording, answer a few short questions about yourself (e.g. age range, country, dialect) to help us organize the dataset. jobs.title: Vice President - Commercials

This role oversees commercial planning, pricing and funding models, business case governance, and strategic partnership monetization across the Aldar ecosystem. The VP – Commercials ensures disciplined investment decisions, scalable commercial frameworks, and measurable value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Responsibilities Define and lead the commercial strategy for Darna's loyalty products and propositions, ensuring clear value creation for Aldar, partners, and members. Establish scalable pricing, funding, and monetization models that balance member attractiveness with financial sustainability. Translate programme growth ambitions into clear commercial targets, revenue streams, and contribution margin frameworks. Partner closely with the SVP – Loyalty to align commercial priorities with long-term programme strategy and ecosystem expansion. Govern investment prioritization across loyalty initiatives, ensuring disciplined capital allocation and return optimization. Establish stage-gate governance frameworks for commercial approvals from concept through launch and scale-up. Identify and unlock cross-loyalty, cross-business, and ecosystem monetization opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth. Functional Responsibilities Lead the development, validation, and evaluation of business cases for new propositions, partnerships, and programme expansions. Define financial assumptions, ROI models, breakeven structures, and funding frameworks for all commercial initiatives. Own the commercial performance of the Darna programme, tracking revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across all products and partnerships. Collaborate with group finance to define annual and multi-year financial planning cycles, including scenario modeling, forecasting, and financial performance reviews. Establish commercial frameworks for loyalty partnerships, including revenue sharing, funding structures, and value exchange mechanisms. Ensure commercial consistency and scalability across partnership agreements and activation models. Secure and manage high-value partnerships across industries such as banking, airlines, telcos, utilities, and e-commerce. Operate, scale partnerships and identify new growth opportunities. Identify and manage commercial and financial risks related to loyalty funding structures and partnership agreements. Establish governance controls to monitor revenue leakage, cost overruns, and underperforming propositions. Ensure compliance with Aldar governance, audit, and financial management standards across commercial activities. Support audits and commercial reviews related to financial performance and commercial controls. Insights, Decision Support & Executive Engagement Translate financial and commercial insights into clear strategic recommendations for executive leadership decision-making. Provide regular commercial performance updates and insights to the SVP – Loyalty and senior stakeholders. Represent the commercial perspective of Darna in governance forums, leadership reviews, and cross-functional decision-making processes. jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE The VP – Business Intelligence & Analytics is a senior, hands-on leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling the organization’s Business Intelligence and analytics capabilities. Deep expertise with Tableau (Desktop, Server/Cloud), including advanced dashboard design, performance tuning, and scalable deployment. Strong experience designing and maintaining analytical and dimensional data models (star, snowflake, hybrid). Hands-on experience leading, mentoring, or acting as a technical authority for BI teams, while remaining actively involved in dashboard development. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE Business Intelligence or Data Analytics TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS Expert-level Tableau skills, including advanced calculations, parameters, LOD expressions, and dashboard performance optimization.
